About the Company
Our client is a U.S.-based company operating at the intersection of digital media, performance marketing, marketing technology, and competitive entertainment.
The company provides marketing and customer acquisition services to businesses in sports betting, iGaming, and prediction markets, combining data analytics, attribution technology, media buying, and creator-driven distribution.
As the business grows, it is focused on strengthening its market positioning, building a scalable revenue engine, and leveraging AI-powered systems to accelerate commercial growth.
About the Role
We are seeking a strategic, hands-on Head of Go-to-Market (GTM) to lead the company's growth strategy, demand generation, and revenue operations.
Working closely with executive leadership, you will connect market positioning, pipeline generation, brand strategy, revenue operations, and AI automation into a unified GTM system.
A key priority is developing a strong top-of-funnel acquisition engine through owned media, newsletters, podcasts, thought leadership, and strategic content.
We are specifically looking for someone with experience leading GTM for service-based businesses, such as digital media agencies, performance marketing agencies, consulting firms, or similar professional services organizations.
This is not a traditional SaaS GTM position. The ideal candidate understands how to position, market, and sell services, generate qualified B2B opportunities, and build scalable commercial systems.

Why This Opportunity?
  • Own the GTM strategy of a growing U.S.-based services business.
  • Work directly with executive leadership on revenue growth and market positioning.
  • Build demand generation and owned media programs from the ground up.
  • Implement AI-powered systems with measurable commercial impact.
  • Shape the processes, technology, and team structure supporting future growth.
What You'll Do
GTM Strategy & Revenue Growth
  • Develop and execute GTM strategies specifically for service-based B2B businesses.
  • Define target segments, positioning, value propositions, and acquisition opportunities.
  • Build a full-funnel growth model connecting marketing activities to qualified pipeline and revenue.
  • Partner with revenue leadership on growth targets, forecasting, and performance metrics.
  • Monitor pipeline generation, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs, and revenue performance.
  • Identify opportunities to improve pricing, packaging, and commercial positioning.
Demand Generation, Brand & Owned Media
  • Build and lead a demand generation strategy focused on qualified B2B pipeline.
  • Develop owned media channels, including newsletters, podcasts, thought leadership, and strategic content.
  • Strengthen brand positioning and establish the company as an industry authority.
  • Turn customer results, market insights, and industry expertise into compelling commercial narratives.
  • Identify strategic partnerships, distribution opportunities, and industry events that support growth.
Revenue Operations & AI Automation
  • Own and optimize the GTM technology stack, including CRM, lead enrichment, sequencing, analytics, and reporting.
  • Establish reliable pipeline tracking, attribution, and revenue forecasting processes.
  • Personally design, build, and deploy AI agents or automated workflows supporting prospecting, research, outreach, content operations, and reporting.
  • Improve operational efficiency, data accuracy, and conversion performance.
  • Continuously evaluate and implement new technologies that support scalable growth.
Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Partner with executive and revenue leadership to align marketing, sales, and business objectives.
  • Establish clear reporting, performance reviews, and strategic planning processes.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives and coordinate internal and external resources.
  • Recommend hiring priorities, team structures, and process improvements as the company scales.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
  • Minimum 8+ years of experience in GTM, Growth, Revenue Operations, Demand Generation, or related leadership positions.
  • Demonstrated experience leading GTM strategies for service-based companies, such as digital media agencies, performance marketing agencies, consulting firms, or professional services businesses.
  • Proven responsibility for revenue targets, pipeline generation, or P&L performance.
  • Strong experience in B2B demand generation, market positioning, and customer acquisition.
  • Hands-on experience building or managing owned media programs, including newsletters, podcasts, or thought leadership.
  • Strong knowledge of CRM systems, revenue analytics, attribution, and forecasting.
  • Proven experience personally building and implementing AI-powered automations or agents in real business environments.
  • Ability to demonstrate previous AI projects, including workflows, business applications, and measurable results.
  • Experience leading teams, building processes, and scaling commercial operations.
  • Advanced professional English communication skills.
  • Availability to work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours and travel occasionally to the United States.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience in iGaming, sports betting, prediction markets, AdTech, or performance marketing.
  • Background in digital media agencies or consulting businesses serving B2B clients.
  • Experience with media attribution, creator-driven marketing, and performance-based acquisition.
  • Experience developing new market categories or industry thought leadership.
  • Experience working directly with founders, CEOs, or senior revenue executives.
How Success Is Measured
  • Growth in qualified pipeline and revenue contribution.
  • Development of a scalable GTM strategy for a services-based business.
  • Stronger market positioning and engagement through owned media and thought leadership.
  • Improved conversion rates, acquisition efficiency, and forecasting accuracy.
  • Successful implementation of AI-powered workflows with measurable business results.

Why Join Us?

This is a senior, hands-on GTM leadership role for a service-based business, not a traditional SaaS marketing or GTM position.

Practical AI experience is essential. As part of the interview process, candidates will be expected to present real examples of AI-powered systems, process automations, or workflows they have personally built and implemented. Basic AI use for writing emails or generating content is not sufficient.

jobs.excerpt: About RidgelineRidgeline is the first front-to-back system of record for investment managers.
jobs.description:
About Ridgeline

Ridgeline is the first front-to-back system of record for investment managers. Founded by visionary entrepreneur Dave Duffield (co-founder of both PeopleSoft and Workday), the company was created to modernize an industry held back by outdated, disconnected technology. Powered by a single, real-time data set and embedded AI, Ridgeline helps firms automate complexity, accelerate collaboration, and deliver tailored client experiences at scale, without added headcount or risk. Ridgeline is headquartered in Lake Tahoe, with offices in New York, Reno, and the Bay Area, and is recognized by Fast Company as a “Best Workplace for Innovators,” by Frost & Sullivan as a “Technology Innovation Leader,” and by The Software Report as a “Top 100 Software Company.”

Why this role exists

As the number of concurrent customer implementations at Ridgeline grows, our Technical Consulting team is changing how it builds, deploys, and supports third-party integrations. This role is split roughly evenly between delivering integrations for new customers and helping launch a new managed integration services capability within consulting. You will help bring integration code into a single source of truth, define repeatable deployment and operating models, and make every new build faster and more consistent than the last. As a founding member of this effort, you will work closely with Technical Consulting leadership and Platform Engineering, and you will have the chance to shape how Ridgeline supports customers long after go-live.

What success looks like

Within six months, you will have completed training, shadowed experienced consultants, and built integrations with guided support. You will have led the integration workstream for a customer implementation and become familiar with Ridgeline APIs, Workato connectors, and common third-party vendors. Within a year, you will have a holistic understanding of our implementation methodology and of the customer and vendor landscape, and you will have made meaningful progress with Platform Engineering on reusable, centrally managed integration assets.

What you'll do

  • Lead and project manage integration workstream
  • Conduct discovery sessions to develop and document a thorough understanding of customers’ integration needs
  • Build and deploy integrations that are reusable, well documented, and maintainable across customers.
  • Partner with Platform Engineering to move integration code into a single source of truth with consistent deployment practices.
  • Improve our implementation methodology and consulting efficiency, with a focus on reducing technical debt and the hours required for repeat builds.
  • Help define the operating model for managed integration services that supports customers after go-live.
  • Engage directly with customers and vendors to scope, build, and troubleshoot integrations.

What we look for

  • 3–5 years of professional experience delivering technical solutions for customer or internal stakeholders in a software, consulting or complex technology environment.
  • Experience working in a complex technology organization, ideally a microservices environment, with a demonstrated understanding of how to deploy a service.
  • Practical software development or systems engineering experience beyond configuration, including building, deploying, and maintaining technical solutions.
  • Experience owning the resolution of a complex, high-impact technical challenge within a multi-system or microservices environment.
  • Comfort working directly with customers and vendors, and the ability to learn new technologies and domains quickly.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in financial services or investment management (not required; we welcome backgrounds from other industries).
  • Experience championing and driving adoption of source control, testing, deployment, and monitoring practices for a team.
  • Hands-on experience with Workato or another Integration-Platform-as-a-Service solution (Workday Studio, Mulesoft, Boomi, or Similar)
  • Have explored and developed initial ideas about agentic operations: agentic code review, continuous deployment, end-to-end integration tests, observability tooling, LLM gateway, and other related areas
  • Strong opinions about different models and when to use them is a plus!

Compensation and Benefits

The cash compensation amount for this role is targeted at $114,000 - $143,000 OTE. Final compensation amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amount listed above.

As an employee at Ridgeline, you’ll have many opportunities for advancement in your career and can make a true impact on the product.

In addition to the base salary, Ridgeline employees can participate in our Company Stock Plan subject to the applicable Stock Option Agreement. We also offer rich benefits that reflect the kind of organization we want to be: one in which our employees feel valued and are inspired to bring their best selves to work. These include unlimited vacation, educational and wellness reimbursements, and $0 cost employee insurance plans. Please check out our Careers page for a more comprehensive overview of our perks and benefits.

Flow Studio has built a strong customer base through product-led growth. Second, you will run targeted outbound into existing Autodesk customers who would be well served by Flow Studio, partnering closely with the Autodesk Account Executives and account reps who own those relationships. You will work alongside a cross-functional growth team from Marketing, Product, Strategy, and Analytics, and learn from peers on the Fusion sales team, who have spent eight years scaling a similar business in manufacturing. Reactivate was founded by Invenergy and Lafayette Square.

Great Place to Work Certification is recognized worldwide by employees and employers alike and is the global benchmark for identifying and recognizing outstanding employee experience. Every year, more than 10,000 companies across 60 countries apply to get Great Place to Work Certified.

The Senior Analyst, Origination will support and be the analytical and coordination hub of the Origination and Contracting team, owning market fundamentals reporting, price curve management, revenue modeling, and day-to-day management of M&A. This role translates market data, vendor forecasts, and regulatory developments into pricing recommendations, deal economics, and decision-ready analysis that support origination strategy, PPA structuring, and investment approvals across Reactivate’s distributed generation, community solar and storage portfolio.

Responsibilities ⚙️

  • Produce recurring market fundamentals reports (monthly/quarterly) covering energy, capacity, REC/SREC, and ancillary service markets across key ISOs/RTOs (e.g., PJM, NYISO, ISO-NE, MISO, ERCOT, CAISO)
  • Track and interpret drivers of power prices, load growth (data centers, electrification), supply additions and retirements, transmission constraints, and policy changes
  • Monitor forward curves, broker quotes, and market transactions to benchmark PPA pricing and identify shifts in offtake market conditions
  • Maintain market intelligence dashboards and summaries for leadership, origination, and finance stakeholders
  • Serve as the internal owner of third-party price curves from fundamentals vendors
  • Ingest, validate, version, and archive vendor curves; reconcile differences across vendors and releases, and document methodology changes
  • Build and maintain revenue models for solar, storage, and solar-plus-storage projects under various offtake structures, including physical and virtual PPAs, fixed-shape and as-generated contracts, tolling agreements, hedges, and merchant tails
  • Model revenue stacks including energy, capacity, RECs/SRECs, ancillary services, energy arbitrage, and community solar/DG compensation (e.g., Illinois ABP REC pricing, NY VDER/Value Stack)
  • Research utility tariffs and state-specific regulatory frameworks (e.g., net metering rules, community solar program rules, rate case outcomes) to inform origination strategy
  • Monitor, screen, and review utility and load-serving entity RFPs for energy, capacity, RECs, storage, and DG/community solar procurement, and summarize eligibility, product definitions, evaluation criteria, credit and security requirements, and key dates for go/no-go decisions
  • Prepare market updates, origination materials, pricing memos, and deal summaries for internal approval and external counterparties
  • Coordinate with Finance, Product, and Origination teams to align pricing assumptions with the deal pipeline in Salesforce
  • Manage internal M&A review process, coordinate with internal departments and be point of contact for communication with Sellers

Requirements 🎓

  • Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree a plus
  • 3 - 5+ years of experience in renewable energy origination, community solar program administration, utility regulatory analysis, or a related analytical role
  • Strong Excel skills for building pricing forecasts and tracking program economics over time
  • Familiarity with community solar and distributed generation program structures (Illinois Adjustable Block Program, NY VDER/Value Stack, or similar state programs) and interconnection processes
  • Working knowledge of utility tariff and program adder structures, with ability to read and extract relevant terms from program administrator guidance, PUC/PSC filings, and rate schedules
  • Advanced Excel modeling skills, including building integrated revenue models, scenario tools, and sensitivity analyses from scratch
  • Solid understanding of wholesale power market fundamentals, including LMP pricing, capacity markets, REC markets, and basis/congestion dynamics
  • Experience working with third-party price forecasts and forward curves, and the ability to critically evaluate vendor methodologies and assumptions
  • Proficiency in Python,SQL or similar tools for data pipelines, curve processing, and automating recurring analysis, CRM (salesforce) experience
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams across different state markets
  • Strong written communication skills; ability to translate technical/regulatory detail into clear, decision-ready summaries
  • Comfort acting as an external-facing point of contact with sellers, advisors, counsel, and counterparties, with sound judgment on when to escalate
  • Experience supporting or managing M&A diligence or project acquisition processes in renewable energy or infrastructure
  • Eligible to work in the United States without the need for employer visa sponsorship now or in the future

Preferred Qualifications 💡

  • Experience with storage dispatch or production cost modeling tools (e.g., PLEXOS, Aurora, PowerSimm, or custom optimization models)
  • Experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau)
  • Exposure to ISO market data sources and APIs (e.g., PJM Data Miner, NYISO OASIS, Yes Energy)
  • Familiarity with tax credit structures (ITC/PTC, transferability, adders) and their interaction with offtake pricing

We are at an exciting point in our digital journey: with the modernization of our core digital platforms, we have an opportunity to build on that foundation and continue elevating the digital experiences we provide to our members and brokers, with the ambition to set a higher bar for digital experiences in insurance.

As the Head of Project Execution, you will play a key leadership role in turning that opportunity into reality. You will lead execution across our digital portfolio, partner with business and technology leaders to shape priorities, and help teams bring new capabilities and experiences to market.

We are looking for someone who is driven, intellectually curious, and energized by building in a fast-paced, evolving environment. The ideal candidate combines strong delivery leadership with the technical depth to oversee development efforts, identify execution constraints, challenge assumptions, and develop credible options to move the work forward. This leader will work across internal teams, external partners, and geographically distributed resources to drive greater velocity and predictability while helping preserve a culture built on trust, collaboration, accountability, curiosity, and shared ownership.

What you’ll do:

Driving our digital roadmap and experiences forward
• Lead execution across PURE’s Member, Broker, Mobile, and emerging digital experiences, from discovery and solution design through launch and success measurement.
• Partner with business and technology leaders to translate business opportunities and member and broker needs into actionable priorities and roadmaps.
• Bring an outside-in perspective, staying connected to insurance technology, digital experience trends, and emerging capabilities to identify opportunities to evolve our experiences and how we deliver them.
• Create momentum around new ideas while balancing innovation with business value, technical feasibility, and team capacity.

Leading execution across a complex technology portfolio
• Translate strategic priorities into clear delivery plans, driving execution while proactively managing scope, capacity, dependencies, risks, and tradeoffs.
• Work directly with engineering teams to identify constraints and develop practical alternatives—across scope, sequencing, technical approach, staffing, and partner capacity—to keep work moving and improve velocity.
• Coordinate across Product, Engineering, QA, Architecture, Data, Salesforce, Security, Infrastructure, and other IT partners to drive outcomes and resolve issues.
• Lead execution across a mix of internal teams, external vendors, and partners, and resources working across multiple time zones.
• Provide leadership with clear visibility into portfolio health, priorities, risks, decisions, and options.
• Continuously improve how the team delivers, adding structure where it creates value without introducing unnecessary process.

Bringing technical depth to delivery

• Bring sufficient technical depth to oversee software development efforts, engage credibly with developers and architects, and understand the implications of technical decisions.
• Serve as a strong partner to Engineering and Solution Architecture, asking informed questions, constructively challenging assumptions, and helping teams identify practical paths forward when delivery is constrained.
• Apply a strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, cloud architecture, APIs, and integrations, and modern application development to identify gaps, dependencies, and risks early.
• Operate effectively across a diverse technology environment that includes AWS and Azure, GitHub, and CI/CD, React, APIs and integrations, Salesforce, and mobile technologies such as Firebase and Flutter.
• Connect technical decisions to delivery and business outcomes, helping teams make pragmatic tradeoffs among speed, scalability, maintainability, and business value.

Building a high-performing team with a great culture
• Lead with high standards and low ego, creating an environment where people are encouraged to challenge assumptions, raise risks, and take ownership.
• Coach and develop team members while fostering strong relationships, open communication, trust, and shared accountability.
• Bring energy, curiosity, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves while helping preserve and strengthen what makes the Digital Technologies team special.

What you'll need:

• 7+ years of experience leading technology delivery, engineering execution, technical program management, digital transformation, or complex customer-facing digital initiatives, including oversight of multiple concurrent software development efforts
• A track record of turning strategy into execution, identifying delivery constraints, and developing credible options across scope, sequencing, technical approach, staffing, and partner capacity to keep work moving
• Strong knowledge of modern software development and the SDLC, with the technical depth to engage credibly with developers and architects, understand tradeoffs, and constructively challenge technical approaches
• Strong experience with AWS and modern cloud architecture, with familiarity across technologies such as Azure, GitHub, React, APIs and integrations, Firebase, Flutter/mobile, Salesforce, CI/CD, and identity and access management. Relevant technical certifications, such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, are a plus
• Experience driving execution across internal teams, external vendors or development partners, and resources distributed across multiple time zones
• A genuine passion for digital technology and creating great customer experiences paired with strong business and digital acumen
• Curiosity to stay current on insurance technology, digital experience trends, and emerging technologies to identify opportunities for PURE
• Strong leadership, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, build alignment, and develop high-performing teams. Insurance or financial services experience is a plus

‌

What We Do

We're a member-owned property and casualty insurer designed exclusively for financially successful families and driven by a purpose of doing what is right for our members. We provide exceptional service, hospitality and care, we partner with our members to help prevent losses and we create smart insurance solutions at fair prices.

We aim for our members to love their insurance. It is our mission is to create a membership experience so compelling that ​our members never want to leave.

Who We Are

Opportunities to stretch and grow: your professional and personal development matters to us. We’re committed to providing experiences through on-the-job learning and professional development that increase your impact and rewards.


Clarity and kindness: you can rely on us to be open, honest and supportive, offering clarity on what success looks like.


Support in good times and bad: we believe in showing up for each other consistently, not only when it’s easy. You can expect a thoughtful partner, even when we disagree.


A community that cares: we are committed to sustaining a community in which each person feels cared for as an individual. We lift each other up, celebrate wins together and support one another through challenges in work and life.

Who You Are

All of the strongest relationships are a partnership- a two way street. So here’s what we ask of you:

  • Be a student and a teacher: share your knowledge and talents and be willing to listen and learn from those around you.

Staff Accountant-Full Time (Remote)

Our Organization:

CDP, a Boston-based public benefit corporation, uses the collaborative fundraising model to improve the operational efficiency and revenue generation capacity of the public media system. CDP currently provides more than 230 NPR and PBS public media organizations (PMO’s) with outsourced marketing, data analytics, fundraising, and technology services. These services help PMO’s raise more net income, grow their donor files faster, lower their fundraising costs, and free up development talent allowing stations to better focus on local engagement. Since its inception, CDP has delivered more than $1 billion in membership revenue for local PMO’s participating in its services and has become the most widely adopted Public Media service in the history of public broadcasting.

Just as CDP is committed to supporting public media organizations around the country, we are equally committed to supporting each of our team in their own professional development.

For more information visit

Role Summary:

The Staff Accountant role at CDP offers a valuable opportunity to build accounting skills through hands-on experience and guidance from an experienced Finance team. With a primary focus on accounts payable and employee expense reporting, the selected candidate will gain exposure to the full accounting cycle, including billing, cash activity, reconciliations, month-end close, and audit support. Working with colleagues across departments, this person will learn how accounting connects to day-to-day business operations and develop broader responsibilities as their skills and experience grow. This role reports sits on the CDP Finance team and reports to the Senior Accountant.

Primary Responsibilities:

Accounts Payable:

  • Own and manage the Accounts Payable inbox and ensure invoices are processed accurately and timely.
  • Create and maintain vendor records, including new CDP employees when applicable, and collect required documentation such as W-9s and ACH/remittance information.
  • Maintain accurate vendor payment methods and remittance contacts, including ACH, credit card, and check information.
  • Maintain the current-year 1099 vendor/contractor listing and support annual 1099 preparation and processing.
  • Enter vendor invoices into Sage Intacct and route invoices to the appropriate CDP reviewer and approver.
  • Monitor Accounts Payable workflows and follow up with reviewers/approvers regarding outstanding invoices or approvals.
  • Communicate with vendors and CDP employees regarding missing invoices, out-of-pocket invoices, payment documentation, and other billing-related questions.
  • Access vendor portals and retrieve recurring or monthly invoices as needed.
  • Maintain a working understanding of general ledger expense accounts and appropriate P&L classifications.
  • Support monthly P&L reviews to identify missing expenses and potential accruals.
  • Maintain a working understanding of prepaid expense accounts and related balance sheet activity.
  • Support the review and reconciliation of prepaid expenses at month-end.
  • Support the monthly out-of-pocket (OOP) expense process.

Expense Reports & Corporate Credit Cards:

  • Support the monthly employee expense report process, including Expensify and corporate credit card activity, and verify that the vendor is populated on each expense when the system supports it.
  • Support employee onboarding and offboarding in Expensify and corporate credit card systems, including account setup, access changes, and coordination of card activation or cancellation as directed.
  • Prepare and distribute monthly reminders to all staff regarding timely expense submission and approval.
  • Follow up with employees and approvers regarding outstanding or incomplete expense reports.
  • Perform the initial review of expense reports for accuracy, completeness, and appropriate supporting documentation. Route reports to the Manager for additional review, particularly during the first year; thereafter, follow review requirements and dollar thresholds established by Finance leadership.
  • Provide basic Expensify support and troubleshooting to employees when appropriate.
  • Assist with monthly corporate credit card reconciliations, including Visa, American Express, and Expensify activity.

Bank Statements and Reconciliation Support:

  • Provide bank statements and supporting documentation for monthly bank reconciliations. The Manager retains responsibility for preparing and reviewing bank reconciliations to maintain segregation of duties.
  • Research bank transactions and provide documentation to the Manager to help resolve reconciling items.
  • Maintain organized and accurate bank statement folders by account, month, and year.
  • Immediately escalate suspicious, unusual, or unidentified bank transactions to Finance leadership.

Other Duties:

  • Support ad hoc Finance and Accounting projects as needed.
  • Maintain organized, current, and accurate files and folders within the internal Finance drive.
  • Assist with expense and financial analysis when appropriate.
  • Support the year-end financial statement audit and related documentation requests.
  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting procedures, workflows, policies, and internal controls, and assist with documenting approved changes.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with other CDP departments as needed.

Note: Responsibilities may evolve based on Finance team needs, business priorities, and the employee’s demonstrated experience and development.

Preferred Qualifications:

Accounts Receivable & Billing:

  • Assist with preparing and issuing client invoices through Sage Intacct accurately and timely, and serve as the primary point of contact for day-to-day billing inquiries.
  • Prepare, save, and maintain supporting invoice backup and PDF documentation when applicable.
  • Maintain current station Accounts Receivable contacts and applicable CDP contacts copied on invoices.
  • Maintain and update monthly and quarterly invoice-upload templates.
  • Assist with updating the MSB billing tracker for MSB, PS, and CRM services as needed. The Manager retains responsibility for reconciling the tracker to client agreements to confirm billing completeness and accuracy.
  • Update recurring invoicing information by station and product/service.
  • Add new MSB stations and update assigned Client Services representatives when applicable.
  • Maintain accurate license and email allotment information by station.
  • Monitor billing-related email, respond to routine questions, and collaborate with Station Finance and other internal teams. Escalate discrepancies, agreement questions, and unresolved issues to the Manager.
  • Assist with distributing Accounts Receivable aging statements to stations and supporting follow-up when appropriate.

Month-End Close:

  • Support completion of the monthly Finance close checklist and PS close checklist.
  • Prepare draft journal entries for prepaid expenses, accruals, and other assigned accounts.
  • Assist with preparing monthly OOP journal entries and station-level allocations.
  • Collaborate with MMT on station breakouts and supporting documentation when needed.
  • Assist with monthly account reconciliations for corporate cards, prepaid expenses, accruals, and other assigned balance sheet accounts; provide supporting documentation for bank reconciliations performed by the Manager.

Systems and Experience:

  • Experience with Sage Intacct, Bank of America CashPro, and Expensify is a plus.

Commitment to Inclusion

We strongly encourage individuals from historically marginalized and underrepresented groups to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification. We value diverse perspectives, lived experiences, and commitment to public service. All CDP people have unique talents and experiences that create our company culture where we can all thrive and bring our whole selves to work each day.

Successful candidates will identify easily with a set of character attributes, as listed below:

  • DEI mindset: You embrace and demonstrate a diversity and inclusion mindset and role model these behaviors for the organization.
  • A Communicator: You possess strong communication skills and have great customer service skills; you like people and want to help.
  • A Critical Thinker: You regularly look for ways to find efficiencies, innovate, and make improvements where you can.
  • Process Oriented:You’re able to understand, work in, create, and improve processes.
  • A Collaborator: You’re a team player willing to help where needed; a relationship builder whose can-do attitude inspires others; you actively share your job knowledge with team members.
  • Someone Who Seeks to Learn: You are eager to listen, study, and learn new things quickly; you are resourceful and are open to regularly accepting and growing from feedback.
  • Enterprising: You have proven success working in a fast-paced and changing environment; you have a strong work ethic and are excited to add value to the organization and its mission.

jobs.description:
About the company

At Nuitée, we are building the API backbone for the global travel industry. Founded in 2017, Nuitée is on a mission to transform a fragmented travel ecosystem with simple, scalable, and API-first infrastructure—think “Stripe for Travel.”

By enabling seamless connectivity between hotels, OTAs, fintechs, super-apps, and businesses, some of which are entering the travel market for the first time, Nuitée empowers companies to deliver reliable travel products effortlessly. Our robust platform simplifies complex supplier networks, offering direct access to hotel inventory with better pricing, coverage, and technology.

With teams across the globe, including hubs in London, New York, San Francisco, Palma de Mallorca and Casablanca, Nuitée has grown into a global infrastructure provider trusted by industry leaders like Hopper, Priceline, Google, and Uber.

Now backed by leading VCs and world-class investors including leaders from , Stripe, and Shopify, Nuitée is positioned to redefine the B2B travel market, streamline operations for hotels, and enable new applications through cutting-edge APIs.

Nuitée is at the forefront of a revolution—delivering AI-powered, smarter, and more personalized travel experiences for a new era.

About the role

Remote in EMEA, or hybrid in Barcelona.

You'll decide how a category-defining travel company tells its story.

Nuitée powers hotel booking for some of the biggest names in travel and fintech. The product and our partnerships have driven that growth, and the next step is telling the story at the scale the business has reached.

You'll own Nuitée's external voice end to end: brand, PR, events, and social. It starts with one story that works for both sides of our marketplace: the travel and fintech companies that distribute hotels, and the hotels themselves. Then you get that story in front of the right people, consistently.

Marketing at Nuitée is a growth engine. Every story, announcement, and event should help open doors and drive revenue. You'll set the direction and get hands-on with the work, seeing your ideas through from first draft to launch.

What you'll own:

Brand & Creative Direction

  • Own Nuitée's positioning, narrative, and visual identity, and make sure the brand feels consistent and distinctive at every touchpoint.
  • Build one story that resonates with travel platforms, fintechs, and hotels alike, and strengthen Nuitée's reputation with hotels and supply partners.
  • Set the creative direction for launches, campaigns, events, and presentations, and shape design work directly.

PR & Communications

  • Own PR end to end, from partner announcements and press releases to executive talking points and thought leadership.
  • Build relationships with travel, tech, and business media, and plan the outlets and partnerships that matter each quarter.
  • Raise the profile of Nuitée's leadership through interviews, speaking slots, and industry commentary.

Events & Experiences

  • Build the events calendar with Sales: where Nuitée shows up across travel, tech, fintech, and AI, and how.
  • Lead the concept, branding, and execution of events, from sponsorships to our own dinners and activations.
  • Turn events into relationships and pipeline, and measure what each one delivers.

Content & Social

  • Build an editorial point of view for Nuitée across LinkedIn, the website, and other owned channels.
  • Turn product launches, partnerships, and company milestones into stories, and help leaders and teams share them.
  • Make complex infrastructure, APIs, and AI innovation simple and memorable.

Digital Brand

  • Own the brand experience across the website and key digital surfaces, working with Product and Growth.
  • Build pages, assets, and content yourself, using AI tools to move fast.

Building the Function

  • Set up brand guidelines, templates, and processes so everyone at Nuitée tells the same story.
  • Work with freelancers and partners where needed, and grow the function as it proves its impact

Nuitée has grown 10x since 2022, was profitable before raising a $48M Series A led by Accel, and works with companies such as Revolut, Grab, Hopper, and Priceline. Telling that story well, to the right audiences, is now a priority for the business.

This role fits if you:

  • Have 6–8+ years across marketing, PR, communications, or events, building the brand of a fast-growing tech, SaaS, fintech, or travel-tech company.
  • Can turn complex technical products into simple, compelling stories, and take them all the way to high-quality execution.
  • Have led PR and media relations, including sensitive partner announcements, and are comfortable representing a company externally alongside senior leaders.
  • Have created and delivered industry events, launches, or brand activations.
  • Have a strong eye for design. You can direct creative work and build assets, pages, and content yourself, using AI tools to move faster.
  • Are equally comfortable setting strategy and executing hands-on in a fast-moving environment.

Bonus if you have travel industry experience, especially with hotels, hotel tech, or distribution, or an existing network across travel media and industry events.

Nuitée moves quickly, keeps things simple, and gives people a lot of ownership. You’ll do well here if you’re comfortable making decisions, prefer shipping and learning over long planning cycles, and enjoy seeing your ideas go live within days.

If this sounds like your kind of role, we'd love to hear from you. You can apply with your LinkedIn profile or CV. The process is straightforward and typically takes 2–3 weeks.

Why Nuitee?

At Nuitée, we’re not just reimagining travel—we’re building the infrastructure to power it.

  • Massive Market Opportunity: We are tackling the $9.9tn travel industry, starting with the $75 billion B2B hotel market, a fragmented space filled with outdated systems, gatekeepers, and inefficiencies. Nuitée’s API-first platform is solving this, enabling businesses to access hotel inventory seamlessly and at scale.
  • World-Class Backing: Backed by Accel and visionary leaders across tech and travel—including Booking.com, Stripe, and Shopify—we’re equipped to scale our ambition globally.
  • Bootstrapped Resilience, Startup Agility: Having grown profitably for years without external funding, we combine operational discipline with the speed and innovation of a scaling startup.
  • Global Impact: Our infrastructure supports partners like Google, Grab, worldwide fintechs, superapps, travel companies and others
  • AI-Driven Innovation: Nuitée is uniquely positioned to power the future of travel in the AI era—enabling seamless, intelligent, and hyper-personalized travel interactions.

By joining Nuitée, you’ll be part of a team that’s building a category-defining platform. You’ll work on a global scale, innovate alongside industry leaders, and help drive the next phase of travel technology. If you’re excited to push boundaries, redefine a multi-trillion-dollar industry, and grow with us—Nuitée is the place for you.

By submitting your application, you consent to Nuitée processing your personal data for the purposes of assessing your suitability for employment. Your information will be stored securely and will only be retained for as long as necessary for the recruitment process, or up to 6 months afterward, in accordance with our data protection policy and applicable laws. You have the right to request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us at . For more details, please see our Privacy Policy: Nuitée Privacy Notice 2026.

Role Title: Principal Research Scientist (Computer Science / Computational Physics)

Role Type: Contractor (flexible, Part-Time or Full-Time)

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Principal Research Scientist (Computer Science / Computational Physics)s to contribute to an advanced customer project at the intersection of computational theory and AI. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. You will work with frontier AI models and agents to tackle open problems, drive research direction, and define standards for scientific breakthroughs. Your insights and rigorous approach will be pivotal in charting what counts as genuine progress within your subfield.

Scope of Work

  1. Identify, frame, and articulate foundational open problems, theoretical bounds, or simulation challenges where verifiable progress can be demonstrated.
  2. Guide AI models and agents in multi-step research processes—ranging from proofs and algorithms to numerical experiments and high-performance simulations.
  3. Critically assess and validate results, utilizing proof checks, computational reproduction, and formal methods to pinpoint the limits of model-generated reasoning.
  4. Evaluate and document the novelty, correctness, and significance of research outputs relative to current literature and established results.
  5. Produce clear, concise research memos detailing research attempts, partial solutions, and observed model limitations or failure patterns.
  6. Advise on research directions, recommending promising subfields and open problems suitable for advancement via AI models and computational tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. 7 - 10+ years of active research in computer science or mathematical/computational physics, with a strong record of scholarly contributions.
  2. Recognition at the field level—such as major prizes, society fellowships, or plenary/invited talks at top scholarly events.
  3. A consistent publication record in leading venues within your domain, with recent results published in the past year.
  4. Demonstrated success resolving named open problems or introducing influential concepts adopted by peers.
  5. Deep, hands-on experience with computational research methods: simulation, numerical analysis, algorithmic implementation, and/or high-performance computing environments.
  6. Proven ability to rigorously examine technical work outside your immediate area of expertise.
  7. Experience on program committees, editorial boards, or with formal research tools (e.g., Lean, Coq, SAT/SMT solvers) is a strong plus, as is a public record of outlining open problems or showcasing research with advanced AI systems.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Messaging Platform & AI Services
jobs.excerpt: At ASAPP, our mission is simple: deliver the best AI-powered customer experience—faster than anyone else.
jobs.description:
At ASAPP, our mission is simple: deliver the best AI-powered customer experience—faster than anyone else. To achieve that, we’re guided by principles that shape how we think, build, and execute. We value customer obsession, purposeful speed, ownership, and a relentless focus on outcomes. We work in tight, skilled teams, prioritize clarity over complexity, and continuously evolve through curiosity, data, and craftsmanship. We’re seeking technologists and problem solvers who thrive in fast-paced environments, love collaborating with great talent, and approach every day like it’s Day 1.

We're a globally diverse team with hubs in New York City, Mountain View, Latin America, and India. If you're driven by continuous learning, rapid pivots, and the challenges of building in a high-growth startup, we’d love to talk. This is more than a job—it’s a journey.

You will own the surface where humans and AI work together to serve customers — the messaging platform, the Virtual Agent and the channels it runs on, and the AI Services that make every human agent faster and every automated conversation better. This is one of the largest product surfaces at ASAPP, and it is where the promise of AI-native customer experience is proven or lost.

You will set and execute the strategy for a product surface that spans the Messaging Platform, Virtual Agent, the messaging and voice channels (Web, iOS, Android, Apple Messages for Business, RCS etc), and the AI Services that sit underneath them — AI-assisted human augmentation tools. You will become the go-to expert on this domain, internally and externally, and will be the PM voice in conversations with customers, account teams, and executive stakeholders.

The scope will evolve as our AI architecture evolves — as automation absorbs more of the conversation and the line between human and AI work keeps moving. The strongest candidates will be comfortable shaping a moving target, and will bring the technical and customer depth to anticipate what the right target is as AI develops in the space.

What You Will Do

    You will own a set of interconnected product areas and be accountable for their strategy, roadmap, and outcomes. Below is what that looks like concretely.

  • Own the Messaging Platform — the application where live agents handle concurrent conversations, access customer context and knowledge, and collaborate with AI. Own the roadmap for agent productivity and the human side of every AI-assisted interaction.
  • Define and execute the Virtual Agent and channels roadmap. Own how customers deploy automated conversations across Web, mobile SDKs, Apple Messages for Business, WhatsApp, RCS and voice, and how those channels stay coherent as the platform grows.
  • Lead the AI Services that power the surface — such as automatic conversation summary, voice-to-text transcription and AI-augmented response generation. Own how these services improve agent handle time, quality, and compliance, and decide where to invest as model capabilities change. Reason directly about accuracy, latency, and trust tradeoffs rather than treating them as engineering-only concerns.
  • Be the go-to expert on Human + AI collaboration. Represent this surface to customers and account teams, translate their pain into a prioritized roadmap, and be the internal source of truth on how these products work and where they are going.
  • Own the external documentation for this surface as part of the product. Drive a docs-first approach where documentation ships with features, not after them.
    • Across all of these areas:
  • Set strategy and own the roadmap — balancing active customer commitments, tech debt, and platform bets.
  • Work directly with customers and account teams to prioritize and sequence delivery.
  • Maintain ruthless prioritization: actively manage customer asks with product evolution bets; say no with clarity and evidence.
  • Establish metrics and telemetry for each product area so outcomes are measurable and decisions are data-driven. You can answer “why?” for everything on your roadmap.

Who You Are

  • Rapid, Practical Learning: You can drop into an unfamiliar domain and get to working expertise fast, teaching yourself what you need rather than waiting to be onboarded. You pair that with a practical approach to innovation — you know the difference between a novel idea and a useful one, and you ship the version that moves the business rather than the version that is merely clever.
  • Extreme Ownership: You take responsibility to deliver. You do not wait to be asked — you identify the gap and close it. You are the final owner; the outcome is yours.
  • High-Velocity Outcomes: You measure yourself by outcomes, not output. You distinguish between shipping a feature and moving a metric. You can answer “what changed for the customer?” for everything on your roadmap.
  • Effective Communication, Collaboration, and Trust: You influence without authority across engineering, design, sales, and customer success. You overcommunicate to keep stakeholders aligned. You know when to drive consensus and when to make a call. You are highly organized to keep everyone aligned.
  • Real-Time Feedback: You give and receive feedback continuously. You do not save it for quarterly reviews. When something is wrong, you say so directly and constructively.

What You Will Need

  • 5+ years of product management experience ideally in enterprise B2B SaaS and/or native AI platforms.
  • Technical depth to engage credibly with engineers on model behavior, conversation design, channel architecture, and AI/ML tradeoffs — you can reason about accuracy, latency, and trust requirements, not just consume them.
  • Demonstrated ability to own a complex, multi-surface product area with minimal oversight.
  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers and delivery teams to translate pain into a prioritized roadmap.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving to clarity — you can structure an undefined problem before engineering has to.
  • Track record of shipping: you have owned features from discovery through delivery, including the parts that are not exciting.

What We Would Like to See

  • Experience with human AI workflows or platforms and bonus points for products that are agent-facing or contact center products — agent desktops, workforce productivity tooling, or conversational AI platforms.

We are looking for a hands-on Observability / SRE Engineer with strong AWS infrastructure and networking skills to lead a focused, time-boxed migration of the monitoring setup for one application from New Relic to Grafana. You will be embedded in the client's engineering team, while owning the migration end to end and working independently as the sole engineer on this scope.

This is a short-term engagement with a clear deliverable. We value someone who can ramp up quickly, use modern AI-assisted tooling to move faster, communicate proactively with the team, and leave behind a clean, well-documented monitoring setup.

Responsibilities

  • Assess the existing New Relic monitoring setup for the in-scope application, including dashboards, alerts, SLIs/SLOs, synthetic checks, and log and trace usage.
  • Define the migration approach and map New Relic constructs to their Grafana-stack equivalents (Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo or similar).
  • Rebuild dashboards and alert rules in Grafana, validating that coverage and alert quality match or improve on the current state.
    Instrument and configure the application and its AWS infrastructure (such as compute, containers, load balancers, and managed services) to send metrics, logs, and traces to the new platform, using OpenTelemetry where applicable.
  • Set up and validate secure network connectivity between AWS workloads and the Grafana stack, including VPC routing, security groups, VPC endpoints or PrivateLink, and DNS, and troubleshoot connectivity and data-flow issues.
  • Run the old and new monitoring in parallel, verify data accuracy, and manage a safe cutover with minimal risk to production visibility; integrate and tune alerting with the team's incident and notification channels.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools, including Codex, to improve engineering productivity and delivery speed, for example to translate queries, generate dashboards and configuration as code, and draft documentation, while reviewing and validating all output.
  • Document the new setup, hand over knowledge to the team with runbooks, and keep stakeholders informed with regular progress updates and early risk flags.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or observability engineering, ideally in a high-traffic, cloud-based production environment.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Grafana, including dashboard design, alerting, and data source configuration.

  • Solid hands-on experience with AWS infrastructure, such as EC2, EKS/ECS, IAM, CloudWatch, and S3, and with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform).

  • Previous monitoring or observability tool migration projects.
  • Experience defining SLIs/SLOs and error budgets.
  • AWS certification (e.g., Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, or Advanced Networking)

jobs.description:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this senior role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD based on experience level per month and in gross amount. This range acknowledges the strong expertise and significant contributions expected at this level. This is a fully remote role. We believe the best engineers can do world-class work from anywhere, and we hire accordingly. Work from where you do your best work.

About the Role:

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Software Engineer, Security Platform, to build and own the platform the security team runs on: the services that discover, scan, triage and route security findings, the event-driven bus that connects them, and the CI security gates every team's pipeline runs through.

This is a development role on the security team, not a security-analyst role. Most of your time goes into designing, building and operating services in Go and Python on Kubernetes: new services where the programme needs them, the existing fleet where it has grown faster than its upkeep, and the NATS-based event platform that moves findings, inventory changes and notifications between them. The security gates in our GitLab CI (SAST, SCA, secret detection, container and IaC scanning) and the agentic triage and review workflows are part of that platform, not the whole of it. Your job is to make these systems fast, low-noise, and reliable enough to be trusted by default without slowing delivery.

You will report to the Director of Information Security and work alongside the engineers who own detection and response and network and zero trust — your platform is what their work composes with.

At Sezzle, AI-assisted engineering is a standard part of how we build. In this role you will build reusable agentic workflows (Claude Code skills, CI review agents, automated triage and verification) that multiply what the team can cover, and hold that review discipline in the platform code you own.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design, build, and operate security engineering services primarily in Golang and Python, on AWS and Kubernetes: new services where the programme needs them, and the upkeep, hardening and retirement of the existing ones.
  • Own the event-driven platform between the security services: the NATS bus, its contracts and consumers, delivery guarantees and observability — so a finding, an inventory change or an alert reaches every service that acts on it.
  • Integrate the platform end-to-end: scanners → finding system-of-record → tickets → metrics, so remediation state is visible and exam evidence is a by-product of engineering.
  • Own delivery of the security gates — SAST, SCA, secret detection, container and IaC scanning: scanner selection and tuning, suppression workflow mechanics, false-positive burn-down, and the rollout tooling that takes a gate from advisory reporting to enforcing without blocking delivery.
  • Build agentic security workflows: CI review agents, automated finding triage and verification, remediation helpers — tooling other engineers actually adopt.
  • Build the triage-to-remediation automation: validate true positives by hand enough to prove the tooling right, then automate the loop — reproduction context, fix guidance, and routing to the owning teams and to vulnerability-management operations.
  • Participate in threat modeling and secure design reviews for the services you build and the pipelines you own.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation for the services you own.

What We Look For:

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant backend experience.
  • Deployed significant changes to a production application in the past 30 days.
  • Strong proficiency in Golang, plus working proficiency in Python.
  • Hands-on experience building and operating event-driven or message-based systems (NATS, Kafka, or similar): contracts, idempotent consumers, replay, back-pressure.
  • Hands-on experience building and operating CI/CD pipeline tooling — jobs, shared templates, runners — GitLab CI at fleet scale is a strong plus.
  • Hands-on web application security knowledge: the OWASP Top 10 in real code — able to find these issues, fix them yourself, and encode the detection so they stop recurring.
  • Hands-on experience with SAST, SCA, and secret-scanning tooling (e.g., Semgrep, CodeQL, Snyk, Trivy, Grype, gitleaks), including tuning them to a signal-to-noise ratio developers will tolerate.
  • Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your development work today, have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't, and have built agentic workflows that other engineers adopted.
  • Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes as deployment targets for the services you build.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience in fintech, payments, BNPL, or consumer lending, especially with systems in cardholder-data or regulated scope.
  • Working knowledge of PCI DSS and SOC 2 as they apply to software development and change management — the platform you build is what produces that evidence.
  • Software supply-chain integrity: SBOM pipelines, dependency governance, artifact signing and provenance (Sigstore, SLSA).
  • Familiarity with policy-as-code and admission control (OPA, Kyverno, conftest) — your gates compose with the cluster's runtime policy-enforcement layer.
  • Exposure to bug bounty or external vulnerability report triage — enough to know what the automation you build has to get right.
  • Experience with threat modeling at a system level.

About You:

  • You measure yourself by other teams' code - a fix you shipped is good; a vulnerability class that stopped appearing across the fleet is better.
  • You'd rather ship a gate than publish a policy - you know that enforcement changes behavior and documents do not, and you build the enforcement so well that engineers want to keep it.
  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You're not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things.
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting.
    You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit tests
  • Open Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

A bit about the role

As our Senior Legal Counsel, you’ll be instrumental in supporting Who Gives A Crap’s growth and impact. You’ll take the lead on complex commercial matters, including significant contracts and high-stakes negotiations. Beyond that, you’ll provide expert guidance across global legal areas like intellectual property, regulatory compliance (in close collaboration with our Privacy & Compliance Specialist), and corporate governance. Working closely with the Head of Legal, you’ll be the linchpin that helps us scale and thrive responsibly, all while making a lasting positive impact.

  • Skilful negotiations: You could have been in the thick of negotiations for a key partnership, securing outcomes that are beneficial for our mission and our business.
  • Staying ahead of the curve: You'd have been keeping a close eye on global legal changes, ensuring our advice is always accurate and we're prepared for what's next.

Let’s talk about you

You're more than just legally brilliant; you're a proactive leader with a knack for getting things done. You're someone who:

  • Minimum 5 years+ PAE: 10years+ PAE & in-house experience desirable
  • Thrives on strategy: You enjoy collaborating to set clear goals and work with the Head of Legal to develop effective plans for the team.

  • Drives tangible results: You're focused on achieving measurable outcomes, always looking for ways to improve processes and deliver real value.

  • Is committed to continuous growth: You're always seeking ways to improve processes, stay updated on legal developments, and contribute to a culture of ongoing learning.
  • Enjoys mentoring others: You genuinely like guiding and supporting junior team members, and educating the broader business on all things legal.

You give a crap

Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence — us too!

Why should you work with us?

First off,as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the highest standards of social and environmental impact. With our most recent score of 125.5 we’re in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world.

We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that’s why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world,generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right).

Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (95%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, wecouldn’t be more proud of that.

Have you made it this far?

If you’re still reading, we think there’s a strong chance you might be our kind of person. About Lokal :

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.

This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

  • Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
  • Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
  • Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
  • Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs)
  • Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
  • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
  • Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
    Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep India insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.

We ship fast. We learn fast.
And we're now carrying that same belief beyond India, beginning with our first international, locally-sourced market in the Philippines. We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

The Virtual Preceptor is a critical member of our team, responsible for supporting and mentoring new hire providers, including advanced practice providers (APPs) and physicians, as they begin their careers with Curana. As a Virtual Preceptor, you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring our new providers have a seamless orientation experience and are well prepared to deliver exceptional care. You will provide education on workflows and clinical best practices while reinforcing learned concepts virtually in a group setting.

This position will support behavioral health (psychiatry/psychology) and primary care providers, as well as providers joining Curana through acquisitions.

Virtual Preceptor roles are fluid to meet the capacity needs of new provider hires. As such, you may be asked to assume additional virtual educational roles or support on-the-job training as needs arise. Occasional opportunities for direct patient care may be available depending on coverage needs and reasonable proximity to a Curana facility.

  • Help deliver a seamless and supportive orientation experience for a cohort of new providers each month

  • Facilitate interactive discussions, case reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions
  • Offer constructive feedback and coaching on patient charts and documentation submitted by new providers to ensure adherence to Curana best practices
  • Offer personalized support to individual providers to address their questions, concerns, and challenges, including a regular cadence of 1:1 communication
  • Help troubleshoot facility, documentation, clinical, and workflow challenges
  • Foster a sense of community and connection among providers in each start class
  • Partner with hiring managers to ensure a smooth onboarding process for new providers
  • Ensure critical orientation checklist items are satisfactorily completed
  • Provide feedback and suggestions to hiring managers on the new provider ramp experience
  • Coordinate with learning operations team members to ensure relevant learner data is captured in our systems of record, including orientation checklists
  • Communicate with local and regional teams as necessary
  • Participate in program improvement enhancements
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Curana's model of care and operational workflows
  • Actively engage in Learning and Development and Curana team meetings
  • Be a positive Curana culture ambassador
  • Comply with all Curana policies and uphold professional standards

Qualifications

Skills and Abilities

  • Able to manage virtual educational sessions
  • Knowledge of both primary care medicine and behavioral health
  • Passionate about teaching and mentoring
  • Energetic communicator and empathetic facilitator
  • Supportive and patient teacher willing to meet learners where they are
  • Organized, punctual, and proactive in communications and work product
  • Resourceful and innovative problem-solving abilities
  • Willingness to adapt to the shifting needs of a rapidly growing organization
  • Team player with excellent interpersonal skills

Requirements

  • Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant with at least two years of experience as an NP or PA
  • Unencumbered professional license
  • Current national certification in primary care: FNP, AGPCNP (Adult-Gerontology Primary Care), or PA-C (NCCPA)
  • Psychiatric-mental health qualification:

    • For PAs: NCCPA CAQ in Psychiatry, or at least two years of documented behavioral health experience
  • Clinical experience in both primary care and behavioral health
  • Ability to provide a professional environment free of noise and interruptions during educational sessions

  • Reliable internet and connectivity to support virtual learning sessions and other work-related activities
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Microsoft Teams

Highly Preferred

  • Experience in geriatric care
  • Experience working in skilled nursing, long-term care, and/or senior living settings

Preferred

  • Experience with value-based care models and quality measures
  • Experience in adult education, training, or skills development

Travel Requirements

Remote, with up to 10% travel for leadership development, team building, or strategy meetings, and local travel for direct patient care if applicable.

Content for iGaming isn’t like content anywhere else. The compliance requirements are strict, the editorial standards are high, and the volumes are significant. As a Senior Content Specialist at Receptional you’ll be running the content production operation for our off-page link-building campaigns — owning the brief-to-publish pipeline across AI-assisted and freelance production models, managing the freelance bench, setting and holding editorial standards, and keeping a complex multi-source operation running reliably to SLA.

What We're Looking For


You’ll need to be an experienced content operator as much as a writer — someone who can set a standard, build a process, manage a bench of freelancers, and keep a high-volume pipeline running without quality slipping. The iGaming sector adds a compliance layer that’s non-negotiable at this level: thorough, current knowledge of advertising regulations and responsible gambling standards is essential, not desirable. And a genuine passion for sport isn’t a nice-to-have — it’s foundational to doing this job well.

Monthly content planned and delivered to target. Content margin — AI, freelance, and third-party spend held within agreed parameters. QA pass rate, client acceptance, and revision rates meeting targets. SLA adherence by content type. Zero compliance issues across all submitted content. Bench health — qualified cover across all iGaming content types with no single point of failure. Direct reports progressing against agreed SMART goals and development plans.

This is a remote position.

OmniShelf empowers small-format retailers (Convenience, Liquor, Petrol Stations, Health & Beauty) with real-time store intelligence via our AI and Computer Vision platform. Store teams use standard mobile devices to instantly scan shelves, detect stock-outs, improve planogram compliance, and boost sales. Our unique edge computing approach processes data 100% offline directly on the device (scanning, analysis, reporting, task creation), ensuring fast, reliable store automation without cloud dependency or downtime. We provide actionable insights to store employees and managers to drive efficiency and growth for retailers often underserved by complex tech to ensure “Right Product. Right Shelf. Every Time.”

As the Pre-Sales Support Manager (Solution Architect role) for Europe, you will be the definitive technical "closer" supporting our Channel Partnership strategy across the UK, DACH, Benelux, and Nordic regions. Your primary mandate is highly commercial: you will partner with sales to technically validate our edge-computing solution for Tier-1 partners, System Integrators, and enterprise clients. Because our AI StoreOS is designed to be highly complementary to existing Point of Sale (POS) and Electronic Shelf Label (ESL) systems, you will architect, pitch, and demonstrate seamless integrations with legacy enterprise hardware from providers like Zebra, Solum, and Diebold Nixdorf to drive revenue.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Pre-Sales Deal Support & Strategy:
    • Act as the technical co-pilot to the Channel Partnership Manager Europe and regional Sales Directors. Lead technical discovery workshops, uncover client pain points, and map OmniShelf’s capabilities directly to their business and IT requirements.
  • Solution Architecture & Pitching
    • Architect and confidently present integration workflows to C-level technical buyers (CIOs/CTOs). Demonstrate how OmniShelf’s edge-computing software rides on top of existing POS and ESL deployments without requiring massive CAPEX or cloud computing costs.
  • Objection Handling & PoC Execution
    • Own the technical win. Anticipate and neutralize complex IT security, networking, and integration objections. Design, deploy, and manage highly successful, conversion-focused Proof of Concept (PoC) pilots for tier-1 retail chains.
  • Partner Technical Enablement
    • Serve as the primary pre-sales evangelist for our regional channel partners (VARs, System Integrators). Train and equip their sales engineering teams to pitch and demonstrate the OmniShelf platform effectively.
  • Tier 1 Hardware Synergy
    • Act as the commercial-technical liaison when collaborating with global hardware partners (Diebold Nixdorf, Solum, Zebra), ensuring our joint value proposition is technically sound and ready for market.
  • R&D Feedback Loop
    • Act as the voice of the European market to our core engineering teams. Translate lost deals or technical bottlenecks into actionable product roadmap requests.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of elite experience as a Pre-Sales Solution Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Solutions Consultant within B2B SaaS, retail technology, or edge computing.

  • A deeply commercial mindset: you measure your success by deals closed and partner revenue generated, not just technical deployments.
