Zusätzlich bewerten Sie Transport- und Logistiksysteme, die den Bahnverkehr, Häfen und Lieferketten steuern, einschließlich Signaltechnik und vernetzter IoT-Lösungen. Sie sind außerdem in der Öl-, Gas- und Chemieindustrie tätig, analysieren hochkomplexe und sicherheitskritische Steuerungssysteme sowie Smart Buildings und moderne Infrastrukturen. Dort testen Sie Gebäudeleittechnik, Zutrittskontrollsysteme und vernetzte Technologien in Büros, Krankenhäusern und Rechenzentren.

Wir gehen weit über standardisierte Checklisten hinaus. Sie simulieren realistische Angriffsszenarien, bewegen sich über IT-/OT-Grenzen hinweg und decken Schwachstellen in industriellen Umgebungen auf. Wenn Sie verstehen, worin sich OT von IT unterscheidet und wie OT-Systeme verantwortungsvoll und effektiv geprüft werden, freuen wir uns darauf, mit Ihnen ins Gespräch zu kommen.

Obwohl Ihr Schwerpunkt auf OT liegt, werden Sie auch IT-Komponenten bewerten, wenn diese Teil der Angriffsfläche sind. Am Ende des Tages tragen Sie unmittelbar dazu bei, die Widerstandsfähigkeit industrieller Umgebungen zu stärken, indem Sie reale Schwachstellen identifizieren, bevor diese ausgenutzt werden können.

Möchten Sie erfahren, wie der Arbeitsalltag eines Senior OT Penetration Testers aussieht? Werfen Sie einen Blick auf die Erfahrungen unserer Kollegin Dominika Rusek: „A Day in the Life of an OT Pentester“.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Durchführung anspruchsvoller Penetrationstests in OT-Umgebungen (ICS, SCADA, PLC) mit Fokus auf realistische Angriffspfade
  • Identifikation und Ausnutzung von Schwachstellen über IT-/OT-Grenzen hinweg, einschließlich Remote-Zugängen und Segmentierungsschwächen
  • Simulation realer Angriffsszenarien wie Ransomware-Angriffe und laterale Bewegungen in Produktionsumgebungen
  • Durchführung detaillierter technischer Analysen industrieller Protokolle und Systeme
  • Technische Leitung komplexer Projekte sowie Unterstützung und Mentoring anderer Teammitglieder

Das bringen Sie mit

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Bereich OT- und/oder IT-Penetrationstesting in industriellen Umgebungen
  • Fundiertes Verständnis von ICS-Systemen (PLC, SCADA, DCS) und industriellen Netzwerken
  • Sehr gute Netzwerkkenntnisse sowie Erfahrung mit Active Directory in konvergenten IT-/OT-Umgebungen
  • Erfahrung mit Offensive-Security-Tools und die Fähigkeit, bei Bedarf über Standardwerkzeuge hinauszugehen
  • Fähigkeit, technische Erkenntnisse in konkrete Auswirkungen auf Betrieb und Sicherheit zu übersetzen
  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch

Das können Sie bei uns erwarten

Bei Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity arbeiten Sie in einem Umfeld, das OT-Sicherheit wirklich versteht. Wir bieten Ihnen den Freiraum, Ihre Expertise in komplexen realen Umgebungen einzusetzen, in denen technische Tiefe, Realitätsnähe und Qualität wichtiger sind als das bloße Abarbeiten von Checklisten. Sie sind nicht auf Standardmethoden beschränkt, sondern haben die Freiheit, wie ein Angreifer zu denken und jede Sicherheitsbewertung an der tatsächlichen Bedrohungslage auszurichten.

Wir investieren aktiv in Ihre Weiterentwicklung als OT-Spezialist. Ob Sie Ihr Wissen über industrielle Protokolle vertiefen, Ihre Red-Teaming-Fähigkeiten ausbauen oder sich zu einer technischen Führungsrolle entwickeln möchten – wir unterstützen Sie durch Schulungen, Zertifizierungen und praktische Erfahrungen in einigen der anspruchsvollsten Umgebungen. Dabei arbeiten Sie mit hochqualifizierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen, die Ihre Leidenschaft für Offensive Security teilen und gerne tief in komplexe Systeme eintauchen.

Ihre Projekte führen Sie direkt in das Herz kritischer Infrastrukturen und industrieller Umgebungen. Von groß angelegten Fertigungsanlagen über Energienetze bis hin zu Transportsystemen arbeiten Sie mit Kunden zusammen, die auf Ihre Expertise angewiesen sind. Ihre Arbeit hat einen sichtbaren und messbaren Einfluss. Sie dokumentieren nicht nur Schwachstellen, sondern leisten einen aktiven Beitrag zur Resilienz und Sicherheit essenzieller Betriebsabläufe.

Darüber hinaus legen wir großen Wert auf Eigenverantwortung und Vertrauen. Location

Our GTM Systems Engineer will be an integral part of our Enterprise Systems team. This role is based remotely as a full-time employee in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, or Sweden. We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal.

The OpportunityWe're looking for an engineering-minded owner of the systems our Sales, Marketing and Revenue Operations teams run on: CRM, marketing automation, CPQ and the tools around them. This is not a ticket-queue role. Business teams will bring you solutions ("add a field", "build me a report"). Your job is to find the problem behind the request and see how a change affects every connected system. Then fix it once, ideally so the next person can do it themselves without filing a request. You'll have an internal engineering team to lean on, and you'll use AI tools daily to build faster.

Responsibilities

  • Own the GTM systems as one connected whole: know how CRM, CPQ, marketing automation and sales-engagement tools share data, and design every change with that in view.
  • Turn requests into problems: ask what the business is trying to solve, propose options, explain trade-offs, and say "no" or "not like that" when it's the right call.
  • Remove recurring manual work: measure the effort, then replace it with automation or self-service tools that business users run themselves.
  • Build automations, small tools and integrations, choosing the simplest approach that will hold up.
  • Keep the data model lean and trustworthy: retire unused fields and legacy workarounds, and enforce data quality where data enters rather than cleaning it up later.
  • Keep integrations reliable: use native connectors where they do the job; where something custom is needed, respect API limits, add error handling and monitoring, and keep sandbox and production consistent. Collaborate with our internal engineering team as necessary.
  • Use AI tools to build, investigate issues, and speed up routine work.
  • Provide EMEA-hours support for the GTM stack, and use what you see there to pick the next fix.
  • Document changes and follow change management from sandbox to production.
  • Current Sales/Marketing Tech Stack: Salesforce, Dealhub CPQ, Hubspot, ZoomInfo, Gong Professional, Gong Engage, Gong Forecasting, Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Dripify, Ringlead

Qualifications

  • 3+ years hands-on with Salesforce Sales Cloud (advanced Flow, data and security model), plus HubSpot and/or DealHub CPQ.
  • Working knowledge of Apex, SOQL and REST APIs, and able to write scripts in Python or JavaScript.

  • Systems thinking: good judgment about where logic and data should live across connected systems.
  • Understanding of lead-to-quote-to-close and the marketing funnel (lead lifecycle, attribution).
  • Comfortable using AI coding and automation tools every day.
  • Clear communicator who can push back on requests with reasons, and works well with business users and engineers.
  • Fluent English, additional languages are a plus.
  • Ability to work in the country of residence (we do not provide visa sponsorship).

Nice to have:

  • Salesforce Platform App Builder or Platform Developer I certification;
  • Git/SFDX; depth in Gong, ZoomInfo or HubSpot; cloud platform experience;
  • experience with an integration platform or event-driven systems.

DeterTech's purpose is giving greater peace of mind to people and communities, every day, and that depends on data flowing reliably between the systems that run our business. This role adds dedicated integration capability and resilience to the MuleSoft side of the Salesforce & Integration team, supporting integrations and workflows across DeterTech's core business systems.
You will build and support the API connections and event flows linking Salesforce Service Cloud and Field Service, our Alarm Receiving Centre software and manufacturing and finance platforms. Working as a trusted technical partner alongside the Integration Lead, you will share operational ownership of our integration pipelines—eliminating single points of failure and ensuring business-critical data flows continue running smoothly during project surges and periods of annual leave.

ABOUT DETERTECH
DeterTech is a security technology company operating across six countries, with principal UK sites in Prestwick and Telford. We predict, deter and detect risk on behalf of the people and communities we serve. Our values – Committed, Inclusive and Ambitious – shape how we work every day: we are accountable and deliver excellence; we collaborate and build trust; and we never stop learning while winning in the right way.


This is a remote role, with the flexibility to work from home. We also value face-to-face collaboration and would ask for some flexibility to attend occasional in-person meetings or team sessions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Integration delivery
• Build, support and maintain integrations and workflows connecting Salesforce with systems including the Alarm Receiving Centre (ARC) platform, DTCommand and Finance systems.
• Support new integrations as they are scoped for Manufacturing, Crime Intelligence and SmartWater systems.
• Work to the integration standards and best practices set by the Integration Lead.

2. Collaboration
• Complement, rather than duplicate, existing MuleSoft expertise within the team.
• Work closely with Salesforce and wider IT colleagues on cross-system solutions.
• Partner closely with the Integration Lead to cross-skill across all live MuleSoft interfaces and flows, establishing shared operational coverage and smooth handover routines so critical systems remain fully supported when either specialist is on leave or working on dedicated initiatives.
• Partner with the ARC Development teams to align API payload contracts, authentication standards, and data sync frequencies between custom Laravel applications and the MuleSoft layer.
• Collaborate closely with the QA / Test Analyst, providing API collections, mock endpoints, and sample payloads to support thorough integration testing.
• Work with the Technical Delivery Manager during sprint planning to highlight technical dependencies, interface risks, and realistic delivery estimates.

3. Support and documentation
• Provide technical input and support for ongoing integration delivery and maintenance.
• Contribute to documentation of integration architecture and standards.
• Act as a reliable, hands-on escalation point for production integration incidents, triage errors across queues and APIs.
• Monitor API runtime health, error queues, and throughput using MuleSoft Monitoring, proactively diagnosing bottlenecks and integration exceptions.
• Maintain clear, up-to-date integration flow diagrams, field mapping sheets, and operational support runbooks to aid quick troubleshooting and incident resolution.
• Adhere to strict data security, encryption, and GDPR standards, ensuring sensitive customer is handled securely across all interfaces.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

Essential
• Solid MuleSoft/API/integration development experience.
• Experience integrating cloud business systems (for example Salesforce, ERP or finance systems).
• Understanding of integration architecture, standards and best practice.
• Able to work collaboratively within an existing integration team without duplicating effort.
• Hands-on development experience across the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform (Anypoint Studio, DataWeave 2.0, Flow Designer, and Runtime Manager).
• Proven track record building RESTful APIs and event-driven data flows connecting CRM (Salesforce) with back-office platforms (such as Finance systems).
• Comfortable and confident providing independent operational cover for live integrations, troubleshooting runtime exceptions and database/API synchronisation issues.
• Practical understanding of API security protocols, including OAuth2, API key management, SSL/TLS, and basic auth.
• Comfortable debugging integration payload mismatches, transformation exceptions, and network/timeout errors across distributed systems.
• Clear verbal and written communication skills, able to walk through interface specifications with both technical developers and non-technical stakeholders.

Desirable
• MuleSoft certification (for example Anypoint Platform Developer).
• Experience integrating manufacturing, IoT or telemetry systems.
• Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL, with an appreciation of ETL and direct database integration pipelines.
• Familiarity with message broker and queue technologies.
• Experience working in an Agile delivery team alongside a Technical Delivery Manager and dedicated QA / Test Analyst.
• Familiarity with CI/CD deployment pipelines for integration runtimes (e.g.Copado, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions).

jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Position Summary

The Transcription QA Reviewer ("Proofreader/Auditor") is responsible for the quality assurance step in a two-person production model: one transcriber produces the transcript, and a separate QA Reviewer proofreads and, audits every transcript before it is delivered. This is not a supervisory or training role — it is a hands-on production role that directly determines whether a transcript meets the accuracy and formatting standard required for submission to a federal court record.

Core Responsibilities
  • Proofread 100% of every assigned transcript— full sight-read of the completed transcript for errors, omissions, and formatting deviations prior to delivery.
  • Audit— Perform a line-by-line audit while listening to the source recording to verify accuracy.
  • Verify the transcript against the currentTETP Transcriptionist Style GuideandPre-Submission Checklist, including speaker labels, bracketed notation ([phonetic], [indiscernible]), procedural notation formatting, numeral rules, and Oral Decision non-verbatim conventions.
  • Confirm document properties, required bookmarks, and template compliance against the DOJ Case Hearing Template.
  • Return transcripts with clear, specific, corrective feedback when standards are not met; re-review corrected transcripts before final sign-off.
  • Escalate recurring individual transcriber quality issues to the Project Manager rather than resolving them independently.
  • Escalate any ambiguous or unresolved style/policy question through the Project Manager rather than making an independent determination on DOJ practice.
  • Maintain strict weekly turnaround discipline to meet the contract's Wednesday DOJ upload deadline.
  • Work exclusively within the approved Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) environment; no transcript content may be transferred outside the authorized security boundary at any time.

Requirements

Certification / ExperienceAAERT certification,ora minimum of one year of experience transcribing or proofreading digital audio recordings of multi-channel courtroom or other fast-paced, multi-party legal proceedings.Technical SkillDemonstrated ability to use transcription/audio-review equipment and software with multi-speaker, overlapping audio.Attention to DetailConsistent, demonstrated precision in applying detailed style and formatting rules; comfortable following a living, version-controlled style guide.ReliabilityAbility to balance multiple assigned cases, meet firm weekly deadlines, and maintain organized records of completed reviews.CommunicationDirect, professional, and constructive in delivering corrective feedback to transcribers.SecurityMust obtain and maintain Public Trust–level security clearance; subject to DOJ personnel security screening and all required contract security training prior to production access.

Preferred
  • Prior direct experience with DOJ immigration court transcription or similar federal court transcription programs.
  • Familiarity with verbatim vs. non-verbatim transcription standards (Oral Decision transcripts are non-verbatim; case hearing transcripts are verbatim).

Working Environment

This role is performed remotely within a FedRAMP-authorized Azure Virtual Desktop environment. Reviewers listen to source recordings using approved playback software, review transcripts in Microsoft Word, and complete work entirely within the contract's authorized security boundary. No federal case data may be transferred to, stored on, or accessed from a personal device. Standard AVD tooling (VIQ Player, Microsoft 365, approved browsers) is provided; installation of unapproved software, including third-party steno/shorthand tools, is prohibited.

Performance Standards
  • 100% proofreading of all assigned transcripts before delivery, and full audit performed.

The Entrepreneurial Path — Build Something of Your Own

Think of it less like climbing a corporate ladder and more like building a franchise within a proven system. The infrastructure, the brand, the model, and the clients are already here. The question is how big you want to build it.

Compensation & Earnings Potential

Commission is uncapped and directly tied to the growth of your portfolio and division, putting your earning power completely in your hands.

At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions. Through our four brands—OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall, and Custody Navigator—we help families stay organized, communicate well, and foster healthy childhoods.
We believe technology should strengthen relationships and make daily coordination less complicated. Everything we create is designed to lighten the mental load, reduce conflict, and support families through big and small moments.
If you want your work to make a real difference in the daily lives of parents and kids, In Tandem is the place where your impact will truly matter.
As an Operations Lead, Strategic Growth Initiatives, you will be a strategic operator who brings structure to ambiguity, aligns cross-functional teams, and moves high-priority growth initiatives from idea to execution. Reporting to the VP of Operations, you will work across Product, Go-To-Market, Operations, Partnerships, Finance, Legal, and leadership to strengthen how In Tandem executes. You will move fluidly between strategy and hands-on implementation, using AI as a practical tool to increase speed, quality, and operating leverage.

What you will accomplish:

  • Run a tight executive operating cadence, including weekly leadership meetings, monthly business reviews, board preparation, leadership offsites, and the metrics and narratives that anchor decision-making.
  • Turn company goals into clear operating frameworks such as OKRs and KPIs, surface risks early, and drive follow-through on decisions and commitments.
  • Evaluate and execute partnership and business development opportunities through market mapping, research, opportunity sizing, diligence, outreach preparation, testing, and execution planning.
  • Lead high-priority, cross-functional special projects that matter to company growth, from strategic analyses and process redesigns to product launches, commercial experiments, and new-market opportunities.
  • Use AI tools daily to accelerate research, synthesis, planning, documentation, communication, and workflow design; build lightweight AI-enabled workflows, prompts, templates, and internal tools that help teams move faster.
  • Create repeatable playbooks, dashboards, launch plans, operating metrics, and other systems that improve clarity, accountability, speed, and measurement as the company grows.

Who you are:

  • A high-ownership operator who is energized by ambiguity and can create structure without waiting for perfectly defined responsibilities.
  • A structured, analytical problem-solver with strong business judgment who can move from sizing an opportunity to making sure the right follow-ups actually happen.
  • A trusted cross-functional partner who builds credibility across Product, GTM, Operations, Finance, Legal, Partnerships, and leadership.
  • Action-oriented and comfortable getting into the details; you care as much about implementation and outcomes as you do about the quality of the strategy.
  • Curious and pragmatic about AI, with a habit of actively using new tools to improve your own work and the way teams operate.

What you bring:

  • 4+ years of experience across strategy, operations, product operations, business operations, growth, partnerships, consulting, investing, banking, or a similarly high-ownership environment.
  • Ideally, a mix of strategy training and meaningful operating experience inside a company—for example, consulting or investing followed by 1–2 years in an operations, growth, product, partnerships, or business role.
  • Experience in SaaS, consumer technology, marketplaces, healthcare technology, fintech, or another technology-enabled business.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives in fast-moving environments while managing multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and deadlines.
  • Experience supporting product launches, GTM initiatives, strategic partnerships, commercial experiments, or growth projects.
  • High comfort with AI tools and genuine curiosity about how AI can improve business operations, productivity, and decision-making.
  • Nice to have: experience working closely with Product and Engineering; partnerships, BD, channel strategy, or ecosystem development; automation/workflow platforms such as Claude, Notion AI, Airtable, or Zapier; and building dashboards, operating metrics, launch plans, internal playbooks, or executive reporting.
What we're not looking for:
  • Someone who has only advised from the outside and has not owned execution inside a company.
  • Someone who is purely a project manager without strong strategic, analytical, or commercial judgment.
  • Someone who is interested in AI only conceptually, but does not actively use AI tools in their own work.
  • Someone who needs highly defined responsibilities and struggles with ambiguity.
  • Someone who produces strategy documents but does not enjoy driving implementation.
Why Join?
We’re redefining family technology.
In Tandem brings together a growing portfolio of trusted tools that support families, and the professionals who guide them, through the moments that matter most. We bring clarity to chaos and stability to daily family life, helping parents feel less stressed so kids can have healthier childhoods.
Scale meets startup energy.
With more than 20 years of impact and a strong market presence, we’re entering a bold new chapter of growth. We have the foundation, the momentum, and the ambition to go further: expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and elevating the tools families and professionals rely on every day.
Purpose-driven. Performance-focused. People-first.
Our culture is rooted in accountability, curiosity, and collaboration. We value diverse perspectives, thoughtful problem-solving, and teammates who care deeply about building something that matters.

At Cision, we believe in empowering every individual to make an impact. Here, your voice is heard, your ideas are valued, and your unique perspective fuels our collective success. As part of our global team, you'll thrive in an environment that champions curiosity, collaboration, and innovation, all while making meaningful contributions to the brands we accelerate.
Join us in shaping the future of communication and building authentic connections that matter. Whether you're solving complex problems or driving bold innovations, your growth is our success, and together, we’ll create the conversations of tomorrow.
Empower your impact at Cision. Be seen, be understood, be you.

The role

As a Customer Success Manager, you’ll be responsible for the long-term success and retention of a portfolio of customers across a range of industries, including brands and agencies. Your main focus will be building strong relationships, embedding our solutions into customers’ day-to-day work, and making sure they achieve clear business outcomes and real value from their partnership with Brandwatch.

You’ll work closely with the Account Management and Onboarding teams to deliver a seamless customer experience, identify potential risks and opportunities, and ensure customers continue to see the value of Brandwatch over the long term.

Professional Danish and English is required, along with experience working with clients in the Nordic market. Additional Nordic language skills would be a plus.

Duties and responsabilities

The role is defined, but not limited to, the following:

  • Own customer retention across your portfolio, managing renewals and working closely with Account Managers on Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), retention plans and growth opportunities.
  • Build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders, ensuring Brandwatch’s solutions are aligned with customers’ business goals and long-term strategy.
  • Drive customer adoption by overseeing the onboarding journey in partnership with a dedicated Onboarding Specialist, and leading training and best-practice initiatives to maximise value and return on investment.
  • Grow accounts by increasing adoption across teams, departments and use cases, helping customers get more value from the platform and embed Brandwatch more deeply into their workflows and business processes.
  • Be the customer’s voice within Brandwatch by identifying and sharing product feedback, while managing expectations around product enhancements and roadmap priorities.
  • Build a strong community of Brandwatch customers by sharing best practices, success stories and lessons learned.
  • Maintain accurate customer records, opportunities and renewal information across CRM and customer success systems.
  • Partner with Product Support to ensure customer issues are resolved effectively and in a timely manner.
  • Orchestrate the wider account team, working closely with Onboarding Specialists, Account Managers and Professional Services to deliver a seamless, joined-up customer experience.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to your customers, helping them achieve their business objectives and realise the full value of Brandwatch.

Essential Skills and Experience

  • 3+ years’ experience in a Customer Success role, ideally within SaaS or a similar technology environment.
  • Experience working towards commercial and retention targets, with a strong understanding of renewals and account growth.
  • Proven experience managing customer portfolios and delivering strong retention and renewal outcomes.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build relationships and engage stakeholders at all levels, including senior and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of social media platforms and social listening/monitoring tools.
  • Experience working with global customers across multiple teams and regions.
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • A proactive, commercially minded approach, with strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Experience developing and executing strategic account plans.
  • Familiarity with data analysis and using customer insights to identify risks, opportunities and areas for growth.
  • Experience using CRM and customer success platforms such as Salesforce, Gainsight, Zendesk, Zuora or JIRA.
  • Fluent Danish and English are required.
  • Additional Nordic language skills are a plus.

If this opportunity feels like the right fit for you, we’d love to hear from you! Please note that for this role, we are only able to consider candidates who are already based in the country of employment.

Papaya Global is a rapidly growing, award-winning B2B tech unicorn with an ambitious mission to revolutionize the payroll & payments industry. With over $400M raised from multiple tier-one investors, our innovative technology provides a comprehensive solution for managing global workforces, encompassing everything from hiring and onboarding to managing and paying employees in over 160 countries.

We are looking for a Senior AML & Financial Crime Specialist to strengthen our Global Compliance Operations team. This role is ideal for an experienced AML professional with a strong investigative mindset and expertise in transaction monitoring, financial crime risk, and cross-border payments.

The successful candidate will support the continuous enhancement of our AML framework, lead complex investigations, improve operational processes, and act as a technical reference for the wider Compliance team. This is a hands-on role with opportunities to mentor junior team members while continuing to develop as a subject matter expert.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct complex AML investigations, transaction monitoring reviews, and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) using a risk-based approach.
  • Support the continuous improvement of AML controls, monitoring scenarios, and financial crime processes.
  • Collaborate with Compliance, Product, Risk, Operations, and Engineering teams to strengthen financial crime prevention capabilities.
  • Perform risk assessments, identify emerging financial crime trends, and recommend control enhancements.
  • Contribute to regulatory reporting, internal procedures, training initiatives, and quality assurance activities.
  • Mentor junior analysts and provide subject matter expertise across the Compliance function.

Requirements

  • 5–8 years of experience in AML, Financial Crime, Compliance, or Fraud within fintech, banking, payments, or other regulated financial institutions.
  • Strong experience in transaction monitoring, AML investigations, KYC/KYB, Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), sanctions screening, and risk-based compliance frameworks.
  • Solid understanding of international AML/CFT regulations and FATF recommendations.
  • Experience supporting financial crime programs in a cross-border payments, fintech, or banking environment.
  • Self-starter with a proactive mindset, capable of working independently and driving initiatives with minimal supervision.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving priorities and ambiguity.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to balance operational execution and continuous improvement.
  • Professional proficiency in English.

Nice to have

  • Experience within a fintech, Payment Service Provider (PSP), payroll, or other global payments environment.
  • Exposure to cryptocurrency products, blockchain analytics, or crypto-related financial crime investigations.
  • CAMS, ICA, CFCS, or equivalent AML certification.
  • Experience with AML monitoring platforms, case management systems, or data analysis tools.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionTripleTen is a service that empowers people, regardless of their prior experience, to embark on the exciting and challenging journey of mastering tech professions.
jobs.description:
Description

TripleTen is a service that empowers people, regardless of their prior experience, to embark on the exciting and challenging journey of mastering tech professions. Our bootcamps focus on training students in Data Analytics, Data Science, Web Development, Quality Assurance (QA) Engineering, and UX/UI Design — in an accessible and practical way, supporting them until they successfully thrive in a new career.

🚀 Our mission is to ensure that every student has the opportunity to successfully master a new profession, find their purpose, and become a valuable member of the tech industry.

What is our goal? We are continuously looking for experienced Data Science professionals who want to support and guide our students on their path to becoming professional developers. This is a full-time teaching role with an expectation of 40 hours per week. The schedule can be flexible, but you must be consistently available to support students throughout their learning journey.

How to apply? Apply here. We review applications on a rolling basis, and candidates whose profiles align with the role will be invited to complete a digital interview, and complete a short technical test task.

If a vacancy is available, we will assign it to you right away; otherwise, we will keep your profile and completed task on file for future opportunities.

📌 Please submit your CV in English.

What you will do

  • Host regular live Q&A sessions to help students unblock and progress confidently
  • Offer personalized support through 1:1 video calls to answer questions and guide assignments
  • Occasionally respond to student questions via direct messages
  • Lead live lessons on core program topics and industry-relevant skills
  • Share your professional insights and best practices to support the learning community
  • Review student projects and provide feedback based on program standards
  • Write clear, actionable feedback to help students improve and meet expectations
  • Support students in text by explaining concepts, troubleshooting code, and clarifying project or review questions

Requirements

  • More than 2 years of experience working as a Data Scientist.
  • Experience working as an analyst using Python.
  • More than 1 year of experience working on machine learning projects.
  • Familiarity with libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Scikit-learn.
  • Intermediate English level.
  • Native or advanced Spanish proficiency.

What we can offer you

  • Training in mentoring and communication techniques.
  • The opportunity to teach while continuing your main job.
  • The chance to share knowledge and experience with developers within our community.
  • Cross-cultural collaboration experience through mentoring and webinar facilitation.
  • Remote collaboration with a schedule that is convenient for both you and the team. We do not focus on micromanagement.
  • A comfortable digital office environment. We use modern digital tools such as Miro, Notion, Zoom, and others to ensure smooth collaboration.
  • A diverse and close-knit team distributed across the U.S. and Latin America.

Description

Pre- Sales Engineer – Europe (Italy)

About the job

Driivz, a Vontier company, powers the e-mobility revolution with a market-leading, end-to-end EV Charging and Energy Management platform for global charge point operators and electric mobility service providers.

We offer a scalable, integrated SaaS solution that enables our clients to efficiently manage their networks and provide EV drivers with exceptional charging experience.

Operating in over 35 countries in the US, Europe and Asia, we enable hundreds of millions of events for millions of EV drivers and manage more than 200,000 public chargers (100,000s in roaming).

Our customers include global industry leaders such as EVgo, Volvo Group, Shell, Circle K, Mer, Recharge, Kople, ESB, CEZ, MOL Group, ST1, and eMobility Power.

Join our team to work alongside the most brilliant and disruptive minds that are focused on leading the eMobility industry and building a greener world.

We are looking for a highly skilled and customer‑focused Pre‑Sales Solution Engineer to join our global Pre‑Sales team.

In this role, you will partner closely with Sales, Product, R&D, Operations, and Sales Operations to support both new and existing business opportunities. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will translate customer needs into compelling, scalable solutions and help drive the entire sales cycle—from qualification to contract signing.

﻿Reporting Line

Reports to the Head of Business Operations & Pre‑Sales

Key Responsibilities

Pre-Sales & Customer Engagement

  • Support the full sales lifecycle—from qualification to closure
  • Engage with prospects/customers to understand business and technical requirements
  • Lead discovery sessions, workshops, and customer meetings
  • Build strong, long‑term customer and partner relationships

Solution Design & Architecture

  • Design end‑to‑end technical and business solutions
  • Act as solution architect for strategic deals, RFPs/RFQs, and complex bids
  • Translate requirements into scalable, cost‑efficient solution architectures
  • Define integrations, implementation scope, and technical approaches

Product Demonstrations & Presentations

  • Lead high‑impact product demos for both technical and executive audiences
  • Deliver value‑driven presentations showing ROI and competitive differentiation
  • Customize demos based on use cases and vertical needs

Internal Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product, R&D, Operations, and Sales Ops
  • Lead internal pre‑sales processes and coordinate cross‑functional alignment
  • Provide customer insights to influence product roadmap decisions

Commercial & Proposal Support

  • Contribute to commercial proposals and technical documentation
  • Develop technical material for RFP/RFQ responses
  • Prepare PoC/pilot proposals and support business cases/ROI models

Enablement & Knowledge Sharing

  • Conduct product training for customers and internal teams
  • Support onboarding and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Share best practices to elevate the pre‑sales function

Requirements

Skills, Experience & Qualifications

Required

  • Fluent English – Mandatory
  • Professional French, Italian, German, Spanish (spoken and written) – an advantage
  • At least 5 years of proven experience in Pre-Sales, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Sales roles
  • Strong ability to understand and translate customer needs into solutions

Description

MEDvidi is seeking experienced Telehealth Mental Health Providers to join our growing team. This is a fully remote, 1099 contractor opportunity offering flexibility, strong patient demand, and a highly supported clinical environment.

At MEDvidi, we provide comprehensive mental health evaluations and treatment for adult patients experiencing conditions such as ADHD, anxiety, depression, insomnia, and mild-to-moderate OCD.

We’re reimagining how care is delivered. Here’s what sets us apart:

  • Full administrative support – no need to hire or manage staff; dedicated assistants handle scheduling, patient communication, and logistics
  • Streamlined technology – proprietary EMR with integrated PDMP and e-prescribing tools
  • Reduced administrative burden – automated workflows and AI-supported documentation tools
  • No software costs – our platform is fully provided at no cost to you
  • Low no-show rates – consistent patient flow and reliable earnings
  • Flexible scheduling – build your own schedule with the ability to increase volume over time

Compensation:

This is a 1099 contractor role with payment per completed appointment:

  • Physicians (MD/DO):
  • Initial evaluations (30 min): ~$60 per visit
  • Follow-ups (15 min): ~$40 per visit
  • Nurse Practitioners (PMHNPs):
  • Initial evaluations (30 min): ~$45 per visit
  • Follow-ups (15 min): ~$30 per visit

Consistent availability and schedule optimization can significantly increase total earnings.

At MEDvidi, our mission is to make mental health care more accessible, affordable, and stigma-free. We leverage technology, clinical expertise, and operational support to empower providers and improve patient outcomes across the U.S.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive psychiatric evaluations via telehealth
  • Review patient medical history, symptoms, medications, and relevant background
  • Diagnose and treat conditions such as ADHD, anxiety, depression, insomnia, and OCD
  • Develop and implement individualized treatment plans
  • Prescribe medications, including controlled substances, in accordance with clinical and regulatory guidelines
  • Provide patient education on treatment plans, medication usage, and follow-up care
  • Maintain timely and accurate clinical documentation in the EMR
  • Ensure completion of chart notes and prescriptions within required timeframes
  • Collaborate with clinical and operations teams to support patient care and continuity

Requirements

  • Board Certified Physician (MD/DO) or Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP)
  • Active and unrestricted medical license (multi-state preferred)
  • Active DEA registration
  • Minimum 2 years of clinical experience in mental health treatment
  • Experience prescribing controlled substances
  • Strong clinical judgment and comfort managing common outpatient psychiatric conditions
  • Ability to work a minimum of ~15 hours per week (preferred for patient continuity)

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement

MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionSenior Lead Business Analyst – Risk & CompliancePosition OverviewWe are seeking an experienced Senior Lead Business Analyst – Risk & Compliance to join our growing consulting team.
jobs.description:
Description

Senior Lead Business Analyst – Risk & Compliance

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Lead Business Analyst – Risk & Compliance to join our growing consulting team. This role will work closely with financial services clients to define business requirements, translate regulatory and compliance needs into functional solutions, and support the successful delivery of complex risk and compliance technology initiatives.

The ideal candidate will have 10+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, with strong expertise in financial crime, risk, and compliance domains, particularly AML, sanctions, transaction monitoring, fraud, or trade surveillance.

This is a client-facing role requiring strong analytical, documentation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills. Experience with project or delivery management is highly desirable, as the individual may also support delivery planning, resource allocation, project coordination, and team management.

Key Responsibilities

Business Analysis & Requirements Management

  • Lead business analysis activities across complex risk, compliance, and financial crime transformation programs.
  • Work directly with clients and business stakeholders to understand business challenges, regulatory requirements, operational processes, and technology needs.
  • Conduct requirements-gathering sessions, stakeholder interviews, workshops, and process assessments.
  • Translate business and regulatory requirements into clear, actionable functional requirements.
  • Develop comprehensive Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), Functional Specifications Documents (FSDs), user stories, process flows, use cases, and acceptance criteria.
  • Analyze current-state processes and identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and technology enablement.
  • Define future-state processes and ensure alignment between business objectives and technology solutions.
  • Partner with architects, developers, QA teams, product owners, compliance SMEs, and project managers throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Ensure requirements are clearly understood, documented, traceable, and validated throughout the project.

Risk & Compliance Domain Expertise

  • Apply strong knowledge of financial crime, risk, and regulatory compliance to technology and transformation initiatives.
  • Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable:
  • Anti-Money Laundering (AML)
  • Know Your Customer (KYC)
  • Sanctions screening
  • Transaction monitoring
  • Fraud detection and prevention
  • Trade surveillance
  • Financial crime investigations
  • Regulatory compliance
  • Risk management
  • Understand regulatory and operational challenges faced by banks, financial institutions, fintechs, and other regulated organizations.
  • Work with compliance and risk stakeholders to translate regulatory requirements into system and functional requirements.
  • Support implementation, enhancement, or modernization of financial crime and compliance platforms.

Compliance Technology & Platforms

  • Experience with NICE Actimize is highly desirable but not mandatory.
  • Candidates with experience in other risk, AML, sanctions, fraud, or compliance technology platforms will also be considered.
  • Evaluate existing solutions and processes and identify opportunities for optimization, automation, and modernization.
  • Support configuration, enhancement, integration, migration, and implementation initiatives from a business and functional perspective.
  • Work closely with technical teams to ensure that business requirements are appropriately translated into technology solutions.

Client & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as a trusted business analyst and subject-matter resource for client stakeholders.
  • Facilitate meetings and workshops with business, compliance, risk, operations, and technology teams.
  • Communicate complex business and technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and proactively identify and resolve requirement-related issues.
  • Present findings, recommendations, process designs, and solution requirements to senior client stakeholders.
  • Build strong, long-term relationships with client teams.

Delivery & Project Management

  • Support the project manager and delivery leadership with planning and execution of project activities.
  • Assist with resource allocation, delivery planning, task management, timelines, dependencies, and project coordination.
  • Track requirements, deliverables, risks, issues, and dependencies across workstreams.
  • Coordinate with distributed onshore and offshore teams to ensure timely delivery.
  • Support project governance, status reporting, steering committee preparation, and client communications.
  • Help ensure projects remain aligned with agreed scope, timelines, quality expectations, and client objectives.
  • Prior experience managing workstreams or small teams is a strong advantage.

Testing & Implementation Support

  • Develop and review functional test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
  • Partner with QA teams during system, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing.
  • Support defect triage and resolution by clarifying business requirements and expected functionality.
  • Participate in implementation, deployment, go-live, and post-production support activities.
  • Validate that delivered solutions meet defined business and regulatory requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in Business Analysis, preferably in financial services, banking, fintech, or consulting.
  • Proven experience working as a Lead or Senior Business Analyst on complex enterprise technology initiatives.
  • Strong domain experience in risk and compliance.
  • Hands-on experience in at least one of the following:
  • AML
  • Sanctions
  • Transaction Monitoring
  • Trade Surveillance
  • Fraud/Risk Management
  • Financial Crime Compliance
  • Strong experience preparing BRDs, FSDs, requirements specifications, process flows, user stories, and functional documentation.
  • Demonstrated experience working directly with clients and senior business stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of the software development and project delivery lifecycle.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to translate complex business and regulatory requirements into clear functional requirements.
  • Experience working with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.

Matrix is a global, dynamic, and fast‑growing technology services and consulting company with over 17,000 employees worldwide. Founded in 2001, Matrix has grown through significant organic expansion and strategic acquisitions, executing some of the largest and most impactful technology projects in the market.

We specialize in the design, development, and implementation of advanced technologies, software solutions, and digital products. Our services include infrastructure and consulting, IT outsourcing and offshore delivery, training and assimilation programs, and acting as a trusted implementation and delivery partner for the world’s leading software vendors.

With deep expertise across both the private and public sectors—spanning Finance, Telecom, Healthcare, Hi‑Tech, Education, Defense, and Security—Matrix serves a strong customer base in Israel alongside a continuously expanding global client portfolio.

At Matrix, our people are at the heart of our success. We are a community of talented, creative, and dedicated professionals who are passionate about innovation and excellence. We actively attract, develop, and retain top talent, recognizing that every employee’s contribution is critical to our continued growth and future success.

Matrix’s success is built on a challenging and engaging work environment, competitive compensation and benefits, and meaningful career development opportunities. We foster a diverse, inclusive culture that encourages collaboration, continuous learning, and growth—together.

Join the winning team. Be challenged, grow your career, and enjoy the journey in a highly respected global organization.

To learn more, visit: www.matrix-ifs.com

Matrix is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees, providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Matrix are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in our locations. Matrix will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Matrix encourages applicants of all ages.

Our bootcamps focus on training students in Data Analytics, Data Science, Web Development, Quality Assurance (QA) Engineering, and UX/UI Design — in an accessible and practical way, supporting them until they successfully thrive in a new career.

🚀 Our mission is to ensure that every student has the opportunity to successfully master a new profession, find their purpose, and become a valuable member of the tech industry.

What is our goal? We are continuously looking for experienced AI Automation professionals who want to support and guide our students on their path to becoming professional developers. This is a full-time teaching role with an expectation of 40 hours per week. The schedule can be flexible, but you must be consistently available to support students throughout their learning journey.

How to apply? Apply here. We review applications on a rolling basis, and candidates whose profiles align with the role will be invited to complete a digital interview, and complete a short technical test task.

If a vacancy is available, we will assign it to you right away; otherwise, we will keep your profile and completed task on file for future opportunities.

📌 Please submit your CV in English.

What you will do

  • Mentor students through 1:1 video calls, addressing a wide range of questions, clarifying complex concepts, and helping students navigate their assignments.
  • Support students in live “Q&A style” sessions, where they can walk in with immediate questions.
  • Host webinars and other group educational events, covering program content, extracurricular skills, and industry knowledge. You may also participate in non-educational sessions such as New Student Orientation.
  • Review and assess student projects in alignment with program standards and best practices, providing clear, constructive feedback.
  • Engage with students on the TripleTen Hub, offering written guidance and supporting ongoing communication.
  • Share your professional expertise and best industry practices to equip students with relevant insights and strategies for their careers.
  • Create and curate educational resources within the TripleTen Hub to enhance student learning and make knowledge more accessible.
  • Foster a collaborative learning community by encouraging student interaction, building a sense of belonging, and cultivating a network of shared knowledge and mutual support.
  • Host Mock Technical Interviews providing constructive feedback on both their technical responses and interview skills.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience identifying opportunities for automation and designing solutions to optimize business processes—ideally within the marketing, tech, or customer success.
  • Solid understanding of business process improvement, with a working knowledge of how AI and automation can streamline workflows and boost efficiency.
  • Comfortable providing constructive and actionable feedback to junior professionals or students.
  • Ideally experienced in presentation coaching, mentoring, or guiding others in their professional development.
  • Clear and confident communicator who can explain technical or complex concepts in a simple and engaging way.

Nice to have:

Experience working directly with stakeholders or clients to identify needs, pitch solutions, and drive adoption of automation tools.

What we can offer you

  • Training in mentoring and communication techniques.
  • The opportunity to teach while continuing your main job.
  • The chance to share knowledge and experience with developers within our community.
  • Cross-cultural collaboration experience through mentoring and webinar facilitation.
  • Remote collaboration with a schedule that is convenient for both you and the team. We do not focus on micromanagement.
  • A comfortable digital office environment. We use modern digital tools such as Miro, Notion, Zoom, and others to ensure smooth collaboration.
  • A diverse and close-knit team distributed across the U.S. and Latin America.

Description

WHO WE ARE

Come join the company at the center of how the world adopts AI securely. Cyera’s mission is to give enterprises the confidence to embrace AI safely — deciding exactly what it can see and do as it reaches deeper into the business. We started by solving the hardest problem in data security: finding and securing data faster and more precisely than anyone thought possible. That foundation is now the essential AI trust infrastructure for the Fortune 1000. We’re hiring mission-driven talent to put those leaders at the center of our story.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are in search of a Regional Sales Director (1st line leader) who is responsible for leading a prosperous Sales Team within a specific region, ensuring they are using best practices and appropriate prospecting techniques to increase and add to the overall success of Cyera.

As a Regional Sales Director at Cyera, you will be in charge of a given region and your goal will be to build out the territory with your Sales Team, guaranteeing that you and your team meet and/or exceed your given quota.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead the Sales Team in following sales methodology and best practices, as well as ensuring proper use of CRM system.
  • Provides ongoing mentorship to Account Executives to teach appropriate prospecting techniques for securing new clients, key account management, and general account maintenance.
  • Conducts periodic reviews of business, which includes sales call activity, lead follow up, and prospecting and performance for each individual Account Executives, while helping with personal issues, competitive losses/wins, and personal/professional developmental opportunities.
  • Assess skill sets and provide ongoing coaching and feedback to team members in order to meet objectives, reinforce sales methodologies, and provide guidance on career path direction.
  • Identify areas where your team needs assistance/where your territory needs growth and participate in the recruiting/interviewing activities.
  • Guide Sales Team members on how to manage key relationships with principals and select Customers and Channel Partners.
  • Implement processes that will keep the Sales Leadership Team current on the status of all sales activity on ongoing progress while acting as a point of escalation for Customers and Channel Partners.
  • Ability to assess customer information, identify and address problem areas, formulate relevant solutions, and present solutions effectively.

Requirements

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Results-oriented mindset and history of overachievement when leading teams selling large deals in a hyper growth startup environment.
  • Proven ability to communicate effectively in presentations via telephone and computer with executive level customers, direct reports, and the Cyera Leadership Team.
  • Proven understanding of cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), security in the cloud, and data risk. Strong preference for candidates with a cloud security, data, or AI sales background.
  • Basic understanding of various data security and compliance frameworks and how this impacts business value.
  • Ability to teach ways to identify new and existing opportunities through basic consultative selling methodology.
  • Proven self-starter with a motivated attitude to be able to manage multiple tasks, projects, and responsibilities simultaneously and within given timelines.
  • Knowledge of managing CRM and opportunity management systems.
  • Familiar with a variety of sales support field concepts, practices, and procedures.
  • Must be able to lead a team and meet monthly, quarterly, and annual quota requirements.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with the ability to adapt quickly to changing circumstances.

COMPENSATION INFORMATION:

Compensation Range: $385,000-$400,000.

The range represents total compensation, and may include incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.

This compensation range represents Cyera’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of posting, and Cyera may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. The final salary for this position will be determined in Cyera’s sole discretion, consistent with applicable law, and based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to the employee’s work experience, skills, and qualifications for the role, as well as the needs of Cyera’s business and other operational considerations.

Final compensation will vary based on seniority and relevance of experience, location, and position requirements.

This role may be eligible for potential merit increases based on factors such as individual or company performance, time in role, and other discretionary factors.

BENEFITS - Why Cyera?

  • Ability to work remotely, with office setup reimbursement
  • Competitive salary
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Paid holidays and sick time
  • Health, vision, and dental insurance
  • Life, short and long-term disability insurance

jobs.excerpt: Meet the Moment with AlteryxWe're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done.
jobs.description:
Meet the Moment with Alteryx

We're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision - and Alteryx is leading the transformation.

You'll be working on the challenges that sit at the heart of modern business. No matter your role, the work you do will help organizations move faster, see more clearly, and tackle questions that used to feel impossible.

If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here.

Alteryx is searching for a Principal, Cloud Platform Architect. This position is remote-friendly.

Overview:
Alteryx is modernizing its cloud platform to power next-gen enterprise analytics and AI. We're seeking a Principal Cloud Platform Architect to define the technical vision for our multi-tenant, multi-cloud infrastructure — leading cross-cutting initiatives across infrastructure, platform engineering, SRE, security, and product engineering. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll set architectural standards, drive major modernization efforts, and ensure the platform scales securely and reliably.

What You'll Work On:

  • Cloud Platform Modernization— Define the long-term multi-cloud, multi-region architecture; lead migrations and drive cloud-native adoption.

  • Kubernetes & Platform Infrastructure— Architect shared platform services (networking, compute, storage, APIs) for scalable SaaS.

  • Reliability & Operational Excellence — Partner with SRE on availability, disaster recovery, and observability; design for fault tolerance and capacity.

  • Cross-Platform Architecture— Set standards and patterns across services, APIs, and deployment models; guide teams through modernization.

  • Platform Enablement— Improve CI/CD and developer tooling with Platform Engineering; make infrastructure easily consumable by product teams.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Own the long-term architecture for Alteryx's cloud platform, driving migrations and modernization initiatives.

  • Design highly available, scalable architectures across compute, networking, storage, and platform services.

  • Establish reference architectures and best practices; run architecture reviews for security, scalability, and reliability.

  • Partner with Infrastructure, Platform, SRE, Security, and Product Engineering on strategy and execution.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies, prototype approaches, and address architectural debt.

  • Mentor senior engineers and raise architectural maturity org-wide.

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years in software/cloud infrastructure engineering, including time at Principal Engineer/Architect level.

  • Proven track record architecting large-scale, multi-region, multi-tenant cloud-native SaaS platforms.

  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, Kubernetes, and containerized platforms.

  • Strong experience with GCP (preferred), AWS, or Azure.

  • Solid grasp of cloud networking (load balancing, service discovery, ingress, DNS, service mesh) and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar).

  • Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog).

  • Strong coding skills in Java, Python, Go, or similar.

  • Excellent communication and consensus-building skills across engineering orgs.

monitoring/metrics platform spanning time-series data, dashboards, and alerting workflows.

Integrations with live network/infrastructure APIs (devices, services, systems). Automation

that reduces toil and speeds execution with auditability and guardrails.

Backend Engineering (Go + Python)

  • Design and implement backend services and REST APIs in Go and Python.

Frontend Engineering (Angular)

reliable software.

AI-Assisted Engineering Expectations

We expect you to use AI tools to move faster — and wemeasure success by quality

shipped, not lines generated. You will: Use AI developer tools (e.g., Claude Opus) for

acceleration: scaffolding, refactors, test generation, troubleshooting, and documentation

  • while keeping engineering ownership and rigor. Apply agent frameworks (preferably

OpenClaw) to automate repeatable workflows (e.g., repo tasks, environment actions,

operational runbooks), including safe execution models (tool policies / sandboxing /

hooks or auditing patterns). Build and maintain guardrails: code review discipline, test

coverage, static analysis, and secure-by-default patterns. We do NOT want: Vibe coding:

accepting AI-generated code without understanding/reviewing/testing it.

Languages Strong proficiency in Go, Python, and

JavaScript/TypeScript.

Frontend Hands-on Angular experience building

internal dashboards/tools.

Databases Strong PostgreSQL experience; exposure to

ClickHouse (or similar) preferred;

familiarity with caching (e.g., Redis).

Linux & Delivery Comfortable in Linux environments;

experience with Docker; basic

Kubernetes/container familiarity; Git-based

workflows.

API Engineering Proven experience building/consuming

REST APIs and integrating with

external/internal systems.

Tooling Git, Docker, Ansible (or similar

configuration management).

Communication Can work independently on loosely-defined

problems and communicate clearly with

infrastructure-focused teams.

Nice to Have (Strong Signals)

The following skills and experience are not required but demonstrate valuable depth and

would accelerate your impact in this role:

  • Practical OpenClaw experience: multi-agent setups, sandbox/tool allow/deny policies,

hooks, automation patterns

  • GitOps tooling: ArgoCD, Fleet, Helm, operators
  • Networking fundamentals: IP, VLANs, routing, firewall concepts
  • Observability experience: metrics pipelines, time-series systems, log pipelines (e.g.,

Elasticsearch)

What Success Looks Like (First 60–90 Days)

gains.

Full Stack Developer (AI-Accelerated) — Internal Tools & Network Platforms

You'll build software that directly supports real operational outcomes. Real users, real

If you're excited about building mission-critical internal tools with modern AI-assisted

Benefits

jobs.title: Talent Manager
jobs.excerpt: Role OverviewWe are seeking an experienced Talent Manager to support the design, coordination, and execution of learning, leadership development, and talent capability-building programs across a global organization.
jobs.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Talent Manager to support the design, coordination, and execution of learning, leadership development, and talent capability-building programs across a global organization.

This role focuses on enabling organizational growth by ensuring learning initiatives are effectively designed, delivered, and continuously improved. The successful candidate will work closely with business leaders, HR teams, and external partners to deliver structured development programs that enhance employee capability, engagement, and performance.

Key Responsibilities

Learning Programme Design & Delivery Support

The Talent Manager will coordinate the design and execution of learning and development initiatives aligned with business and talent priorities.

This includes partnering with internal stakeholders and external vendors to develop structured learning solutions that support leadership development and capability building. The role also involves reviewing program content, learning objectives, and participant outcomes to ensure effectiveness.

The successful candidate will support the design of blended learning experiences, including virtual, classroom-based, and experiential formats. Where required, the Talent Manager will also facilitate workshops and development programs.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

The role involves acting as a key point of contact for internal stakeholders, business leaders, HR teams, and external learning providers.

The Talent Manager will build strong relationships to ensure alignment on program objectives, delivery expectations, and participant engagement. This includes coordinating across multiple locations, functions, and stakeholder groups to ensure smooth execution of learning initiatives.

The role also includes managing vendor relationships and ensuring quality delivery of externally sourced learning solutions.

Program Governance & Execution

The Talent Manager will oversee end-to-end program coordination, including planning, scheduling, communication, implementation, and post-program follow-up.

The role involves tracking participant engagement, learning progress, and completion of development activities. The successful candidate will also ensure that learning commitments and development actions are properly monitored and followed through.

In addition, the Talent Manager will prepare program updates, insights, and performance reports for senior stakeholders and support evaluation of program effectiveness.

Budget & Performance Management

The role includes supporting the management of learning budgets and vendor-related expenditures.

The Talent Manager will ensure efficient use of resources and track program performance metrics to support continuous improvement. The role also involves analyzing learning data and external trends to enhance program effectiveness and align with best practices in talent development.

Qualifications & Experience

The ideal candidate has experience in learning and development, talent management, leadership development, or capability-building roles within a corporate or global environment.

Strong experience in program coordination, stakeholder management, and learning delivery is required. The candidate should have experience working with external vendors and managing multiple learning initiatives simultaneously.

The role requires strong organizational and project management skills, along with the ability to evaluate program effectiveness and implement improvements based on data and feedback.

Excellent communication, relationship-building, and facilitation skills are essential. The candidate should also demonstrate the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, global environment.

A strong understanding of how learning and development supports organizational capability and business performance is required.

Key Skills

  • Learning & Development Program Management
  • Leadership Development & Capability Building
  • Stakeholder & Vendor Management
  • Program Coordination & Execution
  • Learning Design (blended / virtual / classroom)
  • Facilitation & Communication
  • Program Evaluation & Reporting
  • Data-driven improvement mindset
  • Project coordination and multi-stakeholder management

Impact of the Role

This role plays a key part in strengthening organizational capability and leadership development. By ensuring learning programs are effectively designed, executed, and continuously improved, the Talent Manager contributes directly to employee growth, engagement, and long-term organizational performance.

Position Overview

At Autodesk, we are changing how people design and create, empowering them to imagine, design, and make a better world. The Bidding group within Autodesk Construction Solutions is looking for an experienced Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)/DevOps Developer to help build, operate, and continuously improve highly available, resilient, and scalable cloud-native services that power our customers' critical workflows.

In this role, you will partner closely with Software Engineering, Infrastructure, and Platform teams to improve developer productivity, strengthen platform reliability, automate operational processes, and enhance observability across production services. You will own service health, operational excellence, disaster recovery readiness, security compliance, and CI/CD automation while driving continuous improvements in monitoring, infrastructure as code, and incident management.

Your work will include building and maintaining Kubernetes-based workloads, AWS infrastructure, MongoDB-backed services, observability platforms such as Dynatrace, cloud automation, disaster recovery solutions, and secure operational processes that enable engineering teams to deliver software reliably and efficiently.

You will report to the Manager, Software Development as part of a remote team (distributed engineering team).

Minimum Responsibilities

  • Establish, hone, and facilitate adherence to team SLO / SLI targets

  • Develop scripts and tooling to execute deployment and configuration for service updates

  • Engage in deep technical discussions that shape robust, performant solutions

  • Coordinate and perform major upgrades with zero downtime

  • Keep systems updated for security compliance

  • Troubleshoot complex technical problems

  • Solve live performance, stability issues and prevent recurrence

  • Participate in on-call rotations to support production systems

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of production experience in large-scale cloud-based Infrastructure (AWS preferred)

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including at least two years working experience as an SRE Developer

  • Ability to track and prioritize multiple tasks coming in simultaneously

  • Excellent problem-solving skills

  • Ability to work independently

  • Understanding of DevOps best practices, architectures, and methods

  • Experience with scripting languages, including one or more of Javascript, Python, Linux/Unix Shell

  • Experience with cloud-native applications

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration

  • Experience managing SaaS database solutions (e.g. MongoDB Atlas, DynamoDB, Redshift, etc.)

  • Experience with configuration management tools and cloud automation (e.g. TerraForm, Chef, Ansible, etc.)

  • Experience defining and building CI/CD processes and working with common CI/CD tools (e.g. Jenkins / Circle CI / Spinnaker, etc.)

  • Experience building applications on AWS using services such as Step functions, IAM, EC2, S3, CloudWatch and Lambda

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Agile software development practices

  • Experience consuming, designing, and implementing REST APIs

  • Experience with networking and security concepts

  • Experience with log ingestion, monitoring and discoverability tools (New Relic, Splunk, DataDog, BugSnag)

  • Security/audit experience e.g. SOC2, FedRAMP, etc.

26WD100437 Développeur DevOps Senior

Aperçu du Poste

Chez Autodesk, nous transformons la façon dont les gens conçoivent et créent, en leur donnant les moyens d’imaginer, de concevoir et de bâtir un monde meilleur. Nous croyons au pouvoir de l’automatisation et des technologies de pointe pour inspirer la créativité. Le groupe Bidding au sein d’Autodesk Construction Solutions est à la recherche d’un ingénieur en fiabilité des sites (SRE) / développeur DevOps expérimenté pour aider à mettre en place, à exploiter et à améliorer continuellement des services natifs du nuage hautement disponibles, résilients et évolutifs qui alimentent les flux de travail critiques de nos clients.

Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d’ingénierie logicielle, d’infrastructure et de plateforme afin d’améliorer la productivité des développeurs, de renforcer la fiabilité de la plateforme, d’automatiser les processus opérationnels et d’améliorer l’observabilité à travers les services de production. Vous serez responsable de l’état de santé des services, de l’excellence opérationnelle, de la préparation à la reprise après sinistre, de la conformité en matière de sécurité et de l’automatisation CI/CD, tout en favorisant l’amélioration continue de la surveillance, de l’infrastructure en tant que code et de la gestion des incidents.

Votre travail consistera notamment à mettre en place et à maintenir des charges de travail basées sur Kubernetes, l’infrastructure AWS, des services s’appuyant sur MongoDB, des plateformes d’observabilité telles que Dynatrace, l’automatisation du nuage, des solutions de reprise après sinistre, ainsi que des processus opérationnels sécurisés permettant aux équipes d’ingénierie de livrer des logiciels de manière fiable et efficace.

Vous relèverez du gestionnaire du développement logiciel au sein d’une équipe à distance (équipe d’ingénierie distribuée).

  • Collaborer avec les équipes d’infrastructure et de systèmes pour concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions innovantes qui améliorent la vélocité des développeurs, la résilience de l’infrastructure, la sécurité et la disponibilité

  • Établir, affiner et faciliter le respect des cibles SLO / SLI de l’équipe

  • Piloter les processus, notamment les revues de services, les exercices d’urgence, les tests de chaos, la réponse aux incidents et les analyses rétrospectives d’incidents

  • Collaborer avec les partenaires pour comprendre les exigences et les cas d’utilisation, et élaborer une stratégie cohérente

  • Développer des scripts et des outils pour exécuter le déploiement et la configuration des mises à jour de services

  • Participer à des discussions techniques approfondies qui permettent de concevoir des solutions robustes et performantes

  • Coordonner et effectuer des mises à niveau majeures sans aucun temps d’arrêt

  • Maintenir les systèmes à jour pour assurer la conformité en matière de sécurité

  • Résoudre des problèmes techniques complexes

  • Résoudre les problèmes de performance et de stabilité en temps réel et prévenir leur récurrence

  • Participer aux rotations d’astreinte pour assurer le soutien des systèmes de production

Qualifications Minimales

  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience en production au sein d’une infrastructure cloud à grande échelle (AWS de préférence)

  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience en génie logiciel, dont au moins deux ans en tant que développeur SRE

  • Capacité à suivre et à prioriser plusieurs tâches arrivant simultanément

  • Excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes

  • Capacité à travailler de façon autonome

  • Compréhension des meilleures pratiques, des architectures et des méthodes DevOps

  • Expérience avec les langages de script, notamment au moins l’un des suivants : JavaScript, Python, shell Linux/Unix

  • Expérience avec les applications natives du nuage

  • Expérience avec Docker, Kubernetes et l’orchestration de conteneurs

  • Expérience dans la gestion de solutions de bases de données SaaS (p. ex. MongoDB Atlas, DynamoDB, Redshift, etc.)

  • Expérience avec les outils de gestion de configuration et d’automatisation du nuage (p. ex. TerraForm, Chef, Ansible, etc.)

  • Expérience dans la définition et la mise en place de processus d’intégration continue et de déploiement continu (CI/CD) et dans l’utilisation d’outils CI/CD courants (p. ex. Jenkins / Circle CI / Spinnaker, etc.)

  • Expérience dans le développement d’applications sur AWS à l’aide de services tels que Step Functions, IAM, EC2, S3, CloudWatch et Lambda

Qualifications Souhaitées

  • Expérience des pratiques de développement logiciel Agile

  • Expérience de l’utilisation, de la conception et de la mise en œuvre d’API REST

  • Expérience des concepts de réseautage et de sécurité

  • Expérience des outils d’ingestion de journaux, de surveillance et de détection (New Relic, Splunk, DataDog, BugSnag)

  • Expérience en sécurité et en audit (p. ex. SOC2, FedRAMP, etc.)
