jobs.description:
VIRTUAL and FLEXIBLE | Secondary Math Teacher Tutor (up to 35 per hr)

Online Part-Time Tutoring. Powered by Teachers.

Perform VIRTUAL-only ELA and Math tutoring for K-12 students across the United States with flexible hours and higher pay than most tutoring companies. This role doesn’t require you to be in a classroom to work with students across the country. This role currently applies to teachers with experience teaching 6th-8th grade math.

Tutored by Teachers seeks to close the opportunity gap and advance equity in education by supporting high needs students. We empower our nation’s teachers to provide part-time virtual tutoring to students across the country. You focus on teaching, we’ll take care of the rest. We find the places you’ll make the biggest impact. Join us in our exciting and rewarding mission!

Tutored by Teachers generally pays up to a rate of $32.00 per hour of tutoring (on a prorated basis) plus a 10% bonus and this total amount is meant to cover tutoring, light preparation, logging-in early to start a session, and session notes. For delivering a one hour tutoring session, that is $35.30 per session! Our pay rate is often more than 2X the rate many tutors receive for their services.

Please note for some other engagements where lessons/materials are provided to significantly reduce instructional lift, the rates are slightly reduced - e.g., $28-$30 per hour of tutoring + 10% bonus.

This is not a full time role. Upon being admitted into our highly qualified TbT teacher community, you will be eligible to express interest and accept our tutoring engagement opportunities. Please note pay rates may vary for engagements you accept.

If you want to learn more about us, visit our website:

Apply Now! We’re excited to hear from you!

PLEASE ONLY APPLY TO ONE WORKABLE POST FOR TUTORING POSITIONS. THANKS!

The Role
We are seeking teachers to provide small group instruction virtually to students across the country (grades K-12)! We provide various engagement opportunities to our school partners, ranging from summer academies to remediation support.

Engagements can run anywhere between fourteen to thirty weeks, and usually require a few hours of commitment during the week. We can’t guarantee staffing once you've been admitted into our community, but it’s likely :)

Requirements

This role requires you to have experience as a US teacher.

To be successful in this role, you must have:

  • Experience teaching Math in the classroom
  • Experience teaching in an online environment
  • Working knowledge of Google Classroom and Zoom

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with remediation, intervention or small group instruction
  • Experience with secondary math
  • SPED or ELL teaching experience
  • Bi-Lingual
  • AP course experience (any APs) helpful!
  • Dedication to advancing equity in schools
  • Active teaching credential

Benefits

Staffing and Engagements

We’re currently adding teachers to our TbT Teacher Community for fall engagement opportunities. As we win new engagements, we reach out to our community first to share tutoring opportunities to fill needed positions. Apply now to join our community and receive updates on new tutoring opportunities first! Staffing isn't guaranteed, and usually follows school semesters, trimesters or quarters.

Once staffed for a tutoring engagement, our compensation rate is generally $32.00 per hour of tutoring (on a prorated basis) plus a 10% bonus and that total amount covers the tutoring session, logging in early, and light preparation. This rate may be modified for engagements where teachers are provided more or less lessons (e.g., $28-36 per instructional hour +10%). You can also apply to take on supplemental opportunities within the community, such as interviewing, customer success, working on content, or becoming a mentor teacher.

jobs.excerpt: Forming Our Future togetherFormFactor, Inc.  (NASDAQ: FORM), is a leading provider of essential test and measurement technologies along the full semiconductor product life cycle — from characterization, modeling, reliability, and design de-bug, to qualification and production test.
jobs.description:
Forming Our Future together

FormFactor, Inc. (NASDAQ: FORM), is a leading provider of essential test and measurement technologies along the full semiconductor product life cycle — from characterization, modeling, reliability, and design de-bug, to qualification and production test. Semiconductor companies rely upon FormFactor’s products and services to accelerate profitability by optimizing device performance and advancing yield knowledge. The company serves customers through its network of facilities in Asia, Europe, and North America.

Rooted in our core values — Focus on the Customer, Ownership & Accountability, Respectfully & Effectively Communicate, and Motivate & Develop People — we foster an environment where diverse perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated. Everyone can make an impact here. Whether it's improving products, supporting customers, or positively influencing peers and the community, the contributions of our people matter.

Shift:

The regular hours for this position are day shift.

Job Description:

FormFactor is the world's leading provider of semiconductor test and measurement technologies. We are seeking an experienced Sr Manager, RF Design to lead a team of RF Probe Card Designers responsible for the design, development, and release of advanced RF and high-frequency probe card solutions supporting semiconductor applications across wireless communications, AI, computing, automotive, and next-generation technologies.

This role is responsible for leading a team of designers, driving technical and operational excellence, managing design execution, advancing design methodologies, and developing organizational capability within the RF Design Center. The manager is expected to champion continuous improvement initiatives that increase design quality, scalability, automation, and productivity across the organization.

As a senior manager, this position leads a professional design team, establishes departmental objectives, develops talent, allocates resources, and ensures successful execution of strategic and operational priorities. The role works closely with Product and Applications Engineering, Signal Integrity and RF Engineering, Operations, and Global Customer teams to deliver innovative, manufacturable, and cost-effective RF probe card solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

People Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of RF Probe Card Designers.

  • Establish team goals, performance expectations, and individual development plans.

  • Recruit, hire, mentor, and retain high-performing technical talent.

  • Foster a culture of accountability, accuracy, innovation, continuous improvement, and collaboration.

  • Develop succession plans and support career growth opportunities for team members.

Technical Leadership

  • Direct the production design of RF and microwave probe card solutions

  • Provide technical leadership for the design of complex RF probe card architectures, transmission line structures, and probe technologies.

  • Continuously evaluate and improve RF probe card design methodologies, design tools, design rules, and workflows.

  • Establish and maintain design metrics and utilize data-driven decision-making to identify opportunities for process and methodology improvements.

  • Drive design standardization, methodology development, design reuse, and best practices across product families and FormFactor sites to improve quality, cycle time, and efficiency.

  • Collaborate with RF/SI engineering, measurement, applications engineering, and product engineering teams to optimize electrical and mechanical performance.

Project and Program Leadership

  • Balance design resources to meet delivery, quality, cost, and performance objectives.

  • Manage multiple complex development projects simultaneously through various stages of the product lifecycle.

  • Ensure on-time completion of design milestones, design reviews, and product releases.

  • Provide project status, resource planning, and performance metrics to management.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with Product Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, and Product Management teams.

  • Drive seamless transfer of new products from development into production design.

  • Champion Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) principles.

  • Lead technical investigations and corrective actions for customer-impacting issues.

  • Partner with cross functional leadership to establish robust SIOP processes.

Process, Design Methodology, and Continuous Improvement

  • Own and continuously evolve RF probe card design methodologies to improve quality, predictability, scalability, and design cycle time.

  • Drive implementation of design automation, parametric design techniques, CAD tool enhancements, and workflow improvements.

  • Establish and maintain design standards, design rules, templates, libraries, and best practices.

  • Lead initiatives to reduce design iterations, improve first-pass design success rates, and enhance manufacturability.

  • Develop KPIs and performance metrics to measure effectiveness of design processes and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Utilize Lean, Six Sigma, root-cause analysis, and other structured problem-solving methodologies to eliminate recurring design and product quality issues.

  • Lead change management activities related to design methodologies, design rules, CAD tools, and engineering workflows.

Preferred Qualifications & Experiences:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or related engineering discipline.

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in semiconductor test, RF product development, probe cards, advanced interconnect technologies, microelectronics, PCB design, or related industries.

  • Minimum 3 years of engineering leadership, technical leadership, or people management experience.

  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional development projects from concept through production release.

  • Experience managing technical professionals and building high-performing teams.

  • Experience in semiconductor wafer probe, RF test systems, or advanced packaging technologies.

  • Experience leading global engineering teams and cross-site development activities.

Technical Skills:

  • Strong understanding of RF, microwave, and high-speed electrical design principles.

  • Experience with RF probe cards, RF interposers, test interfaces, substrates, or related semiconductor test hardware.

  • Understanding of PCB, thin-film, ceramic, advanced substrate technologies. Understanding of SMT manufacturing process.

  • Demonstrated experience developing and implementing engineering design methodologies, standards, and best practices.

  • Experience driving design automation and design productivity improvements.

  • Working knowledge of DFMEA, PFMEA, Ishikawa, IS/IS NOT, root-cause analysis, and corrective action methodologies. Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, DOE, SPC, and Gage R&R principles.

  • Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Skills:

ATE Testing, Continuous Improvement, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Design Methods, Engineering Management, Lean Methodologies, PCB Layout Design, RF Microwave Design, RF Simulations, Team Leadership

Education & Experience:

Minimum of 10 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 8 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 5 years experience; or equivalent work experience | Required

Pay Range:

$138,900.00 - $182,280.00

Pay Range Explained:

This role in Portland, Oregon pays between $138,900.00 and $182,280.00 per year, depending on your experience, skills, and background. Pay may vary in other locations. We offer a full benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability coverage, a 401(k) with company match, employee stock purchase plan (ESPP), and paid time off. You’ll also be eligible for quarterly profit-sharing bonuses and flexible spending or savings accounts.

jobs.excerpt: About CarbonCure TechnologiesCarbonCure Technologies is a fast-growing carbon utilization technology company on a mission to reduce embodied carbon in new concrete construction.
jobs.description:
About CarbonCure Technologies

CarbonCure Technologies
is a fast-growing carbon utilization technology company on a mission to reduce embodied carbon in new concrete construction. With hundreds of carbon mineralization systems operating worldwide, CarbonCure’s technologies inject and permanently embed captured CO₂ in concrete while also enabling reductions of carbon-intensive cement from each truckload of concrete. This innovative solution has saved hundreds of thousands of metric tons of CO₂ to date, and that impact grows with every truckload of concrete our producer partners supply in their markets. CarbonCure’s cutting-edge research and innovation have also garnered global recognition and prestigious awards, most notably the Carbon XPRIZE Grand Prize and induction into the Cleantech 100 Hall of Fame. CarbonCure’s investors include Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Blue Earth Capital, BDC, Amazon, Taronga Ventures, 2150, Microsoft, Samsung Ventures, BH3 Growth Equity, Carbon Direct, GreenSoil Investments and Mitsubishi Corporation. Follow CarbonCure on
LinkedIn.

Our Culture

Our team is made up of energetic, entrepreneurial individuals who are passionate about driving meaningful solutions to combat climate change. Besides being dedicated to our mission, we believe in work-life balance and active involvement in our local communities. We value integrity and accountability; and our core values include customer success, earned trust, data-driven decisions, and straight-talk. We don’t take ourselves too seriously, but we are here to change the world.

Purpose Driven Position

Reporting to the VP, APAC & EMEA, the Technical Manager is responsible for leading, developing, and coordinating technical operations across the Asia‑Pacific region to ensure successful installation, service delivery, and long-term customer success for CarbonCure’s solution. This role oversees both internal technical staff and external distributor partners, ensuring operational consistency, high-quality execution, and continuous improvement across all markets in the APAC sales region.

The Technical Manager, APAC, serves as the primary regional contact for technical strategy, installation excellence, equipment reliability, concrete performance, and regulatory enablement, playing a crucial role in CarbonCure’s growth and customer satisfaction throughout the APAC region.

This is a remote position, with preference for candidates located inJapan, South Korea, or Taiwanfor proximity to customer sites.

What you'll be doing

Regional Technical Team Leadership:

  • Lead and manage day-to-day activities of regional technical staff, consultants, and distributor field technicians across Singapore, Japan, South Korea, Malaysia, and emerging markets.
  • Provide hands-on leadership through coaching, site visits, and performance feedback to ensure consistent quality and adherence to CarbonCure standards.
  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive technical competency program, including onboarding and training for employees, distributors, and third-party partners.
  • Establish and reinforce best practices for safety, installation, troubleshooting, concrete testing, and customer communication.

Customer Success & Technical Execution:

  • Own and execute on the regional technical strategy in alignment with APAC roadmaps for Japan, Singapore, South Korea, and additional developing markets.
  • Lead technical delivery for stages 2–5 of our Value Stream Map (VSM), including:
    • Pre‑installation planning and scheduling
    • On‑site installations and commissioning
    • Ongoing preventive maintenance
    • Concrete validation testing (both in laboratory and field)
    • Optimization of system performance and carbon credit revenue
  • Manage relationships and workflows with third‑party labs to support testing requirements for cement validation.
  • Oversee limited‑resource service models in smaller markets such as Taiwan, Thailand, Vietnam, and Hong Kong, ensuring reliable customer support and escalation paths.
  • Identify and drive continuous improvement initiatives to elevate service levels, reduce downtime, and standardize processes across the region.

Operational Excellence:

  • Establish and refine regional equipment assembly, refurbishment, and maintenance capabilities to reduce lead times and enhance reliability.
  • Develop and sustain a vetted network of equipment vendors, service providers, and concrete technicians, particularly in high‑priority markets.
  • Oversee technical planning and forecasting, ensuring the region delivers on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) related to installation output, uptime, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with R&D and Engineering teams to provide field insights that influence product design, quality improvements, and operational improvements.

Regulatory & Market Development:

  • Lead APAC regulatory strategies, including obtaining and maintaining certifications such as JIS (Japan), KS (Korea), and other standards required for new and existing market entry.
  • Support and participate in industry engagement initiatives and customer advocacy groups.
  • In collaboration with the VP, APAC & EMEA, conduct market assessments for expansion opportunities in other regions, outlining technical requirements, risks, and operational needs for successful entry.
  • Represent CarbonCure at technical symposiums, regulatory meetings, and partner discussions as a regional subject-matter expert.

This role will require travel throughout the APAC region, up to 50%.

What you'll need to succeed

  • Strong technical foundation in concrete mix design management. Experience in hardware engineering, industrial equipment, software systems, and field service operations are additional assets.
  • Proven leadership experience managing distributed technical teams across multiple countries and cultures.
  • Prior experience in the concrete, construction, or industrial equipment sector.
  • Familiarity with construction-related regulatory approval processes; experience with JIS, KS, or similar standards is an asset.
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to execute operational tasks while contributing to long-term regional growth initiatives.
  • Exceptional communication skills and the ability to work effectively with sales, technical services, engineering & product development.
  • Bilingual capabilities, must speak Japanese and English; additional APAC languages are an asset (e.g. Korean, Cantonese).
  • Valid passport and willingness to travel up to 50%.

We are changing the world. Join us!

Closing Statement

We would like to thank all applicants for their interest. Please note only those selected for an interview will be contacted. If you feel passionate about this opportunity and believe that you have the skills to excel in this role, apply! Or if this sounds like someone you know, please share this posting.

We want you to know that you can be a great candidate even if you don't fit everything we've described above. You can also have important skills we haven't thought of. If that's you, don't hesitate to apply and tell us about yourself. We are committed to fostering diversity in our organization and building an equitable and inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and experiences. ABOUT US

At DataEQ, we transform unstructured customer and public feedback into powerful, actionable insights. By combining cutting-edge AI with our unique human data labeling platform, we help some of South Africa’s leading companies - including top banks, retailers, and insurers - enhance customer experiences, manage risk, and optimize digital services.

Our innovative solutions are driving real impact across industries that matter.

When you join DataEQ, you become part of a dynamic and diverse team of over talented professionals, including data scientists, analysts, product specialists and creative problem-solvers. We’re committed to fostering a collaborative, supportive environment where fresh ideas thrive and your work directly influences how major brands understand and engage with their customers.

If you're passionate about building strong client relationships, improving customer journeys, and shaping how clients engage with technology, DataEQ is the place for you.

ABOUT THE JOB

We’re looking for an Account Manager to take ownership of a portfolio of clients and make sure they get real, measurable value from DataEQ’s data and platforms.

This is a mid-level client service role at the heart of our Core business. You will manage day-to-day client relationships, drive renewals and organic growth across your portfolio, and act as the bridge between your clients and our product and consulting teams.

You will build deep familiarity with our platforms, Analyse and Engage, and with how our data is collected, processed, and turned into insight, so that you can guide clients towards the answers that matter most to their business.

This is an ideal role for someone who is commercially curious, well organised, and energised by building trusted client relationships, with a clear path of progression towards Senior Account Manager and beyond.

Client Retention & Renewals

  • Proactively manage client expectations, identifying and communicating risks early and escalating issues where needed

Commercial Admin

  • Draw up proposals and cost estimates
  • Keep account documentation, pipeline records, and forecasts accurate and up to date
  • Support the Finance team in following up on and resolving overdue client payments

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

The ideal candidate is curious, commercially minded, and highly organised. They enjoy building relationships, are comfortable working with data, and take real pride in getting the details right.

Experience & Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in a client-facing or account management role (preferably in tech, SaaS, consulting, research, or data-driven services)

  • Proficiency in MS Word, PowerPoint, and Excel, and comfort learning and navigating new web-based software applications
  • Target-driven, determined, and energetic
  • The ability to work flexibly in a fast-paced, performance-orientated environment

Bonus Points For

  • Experience in financial services, telecoms, or retail sectors
  • Experience presenting insights or research findings to senior client stakeholders
  • Familiarity with client success, renewals, or upsell processes
  • Interest in automation, AI, and process optimisation

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING WITH US

At DataEQ, we believe in supporting our team—professionally and personally. We value outcomes over inputs and offer a flexible, remote-first work culture where you can thrive.

While we’re globally distributed, most of our team is based in Johannesburg and Cape Town. If you're local, you’ll enjoy opportunities to co-work with team members, attend regular social events, and connect face-to-face.

Here’s what you can expect when you join DataEQ:

  • Market-related remuneration (including generous bonus structure)

jobs.title: Designated RN Prescriber
jobs.excerpt: G’day, we’re Mosh & Moshy. Our mission is to get Aussies the best possible health outcomes through best-in-class health programs.
jobs.description:
G’day, we’re Mosh & Moshy.

Our mission is to get Aussies the best possible health outcomes through best-in-class health programs.

We know the current healthcare system isn’t meeting the needs of the modern Australian, and we reckon there’s a better, more holistic way. Our programs across hair loss, sexual health, skincare, mental health and weight management are easy, accessible and completely discreet.

More than a job

There’s nothing better than knowing the work you’re doing matters and makes a genuine difference. We’re pretty lucky that, at Mosh & Moshy, this is the norm rather than the exception.

The Opportunity

The introduction of the Designated RN Prescriber endorsement represents an exciting advancement in Australian nursing practice. We’re looking for an experienced Designated Registered Nurse Prescriber to help bring this emerging model of care to life within a mature digital health platform.

This is a genuinely pioneering opportunity. You’ll be among the first cohort of endorsed RN Prescribers in Australia delivering nurse-led prescribing through telehealth, supported by a dedicated clinical governance framework and structured partnership with an Authorised Health Practitioner.

Reporting to our Chief Medical Officer, you’ll conduct real-time telephone and video consultations, assess patients and prescribe within an agreed clinical scope. You’ll remain professionally responsible and accountable for your clinical and prescribing decisions, with clear escalation pathways, ongoing mentorship and multidisciplinary support.

What you’ll do

As a Designated RN Prescriber, you’ll:

  • Consult with new and existing patients via telephone and video, providing education, clinical advice and support
  • Assess patients and make evidence-based clinical decisions within your agreed prescribing scope
  • Manage patients’ ongoing treatment plans, including assessing their response to treatment
  • Prescribe appropriate medications and adjust treatment where clinically indicated and within scope
  • Recognise when a patient’s needs fall outside your agreed scope and escalate or refer them promptly
  • Triage presenting symptoms to the appropriate medical practitioner, nurse practitioner or pharmacist
  • Maintain a productive clinical partnership with your nominated Authorised Health Practitioner, including regular case reviews and clear escalation pathways
  • Complete a structured six-month clinical mentorship program when you commence
  • Document consultations, assessments and prescribing decisions accurately and contemporaneously
  • Participate in clinical audits, monitoring, peer learning and quality-improvement activities
  • Report adverse events and near misses in line with our clinical governance processes and relevant regulatory obligations
  • Contribute clinical insights to the ongoing development of our treatment protocols and patient care pathways

Experience you’ll bring

To succeed in this role, you’ll have:

  • Current general registration as a Registered Nurse with AHPRA, with no conditions or undertakings relevant to prescribing
  • NMBA endorsement for scheduled medicines as a Designated Registered Nurse Prescriber, or an active application with evidence that you meet the eligibility requirements
  • Successful completion of the NMBA-approved units of study required for endorsement
  • At least 5,000 hours—or the equivalent of three years’ full-time practice—of post-registration clinical experience completed within the past six years
  • A current PBS prescriber number, or the ability to obtain one
  • A sound understanding of Quality Use of Medicines principles and the NMBA designated RN prescribing framework
  • The ability to conduct thorough patient assessments and make independent, evidence-based clinical decisions within a defined scope
  • Strong clinical judgement and a commitment to safe, evidence-based and patient-centred care
  • Confident, clear and empathetic communication skills, particularly in telephone and video consultations
  • The ability to work collaboratively with an Authorised Health Practitioner and broader multidisciplinary clinical team
  • Confidence navigating digital clinical platforms, documentation systems and telehealth tools
  • A commitment to ongoing professional development, including prescribing-specific CPD requirements

Experience in telehealth, primary care or a closely related clinical setting will be highly regarded.

What’s on offer

We hire people who share our values, believe in our mission and are passionate about the future of healthcare. Some of the reasons our team loves Mosh & Moshy include:

  • The opportunity to help establish an emerging model of nurse-led prescribing in Australian digital healthcare
  • A structured six-month clinical mentorship program
  • Support from experienced medical practitioners, nurse practitioners and our wider clinical team
  • A dedicated clinical governance framework and Medicines Advisory Committee
  • Meaningful work that makes a real, positive difference in patients’ lives
  • Plenty of opportunity to learn and grow as the company evolves
  • Access to up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave
  • Two additional paid company closure days each year
  • Two days of purpose leave for mental health or learning and development
  • Access to on-demand learning through Go1
  • EAP support and online wellbeing programs
  • ClassPass credit discounts
  • Discounts across a range of Mosh & Moshy products and services
  • A creative, friendly and collaborative team

Better, together

Everyone is different, and we think that’s what makes life interesting. We believe our differences generate better ideas, bring valuable perspectives and help us represent the people we care for.

If you’re excited by this opportunity and are currently endorsed—or actively progressing an eligible application—we’d love to hear from you.

Paid Media Technician - Contract Role

Digital Reach Agency is a full-service digital marketing agency focused on becoming the best B2B SaaS & Tech provider.

We’re looking for a B2B Paid Media Technician with experience in the SaaS and Tech verticals. Your job will be to help support and execute integrated marketing campaigns alongside specialists in creative, reporting/attribution, and development.

At Digital Reach, our focus is on B2B digital marketing, data attribution, tracking our clients’ customers’ actions through the funnel and providing clarity into KPIs and ROI. In-depth tracking and complete transparency are hallmarks of our digital marketing services, helping our clients track KPIs in real-time and transforming digital marketing into a reliable revenue-center. We’ll help our clients with tracking revenue, simplifying and demystifying the digital marketing experience, and presenting it in terms of clear dollars-and-cents ROI.

Paid Media Technician Responsibilities:

  • This role will primarily be in support of larger paid media client teams. Responsibilities include, but aren’t limited to:
  • Day-to-day management of paid digital media, including search engine marketing (SEM), display, programmatic, video, and native advertising for assigned client accounts.
  • Analyze and report on paid media campaign data and performance
    • Data pulls/compilation and deck creation for reporting deliverables
    • Campaign and and creative performance monitoring/compiling to assist in weekly communication with clients
    • Monitoring paid social campaigns for user comments/reactions and addressing accordingly
  • Present paid media plans, performance data, and project updates (internal and external)
  • Support the launch of new campaigns and assets

If you are excited about contributing in a large way to a company who cares deeply about understanding our clients’ problems and transforming their ideas into reality, we’d love to talk to you.

Expectations for this position:

  • This position requires supreme attention to detail and the ability to follow and execute clear and defined processes. Making sure that items are aligned, establishing clear action plans, and providing transparent and concise reporting are all extremely important. We aim to be the best digital marketing agency geared towards B2B SaaS & Tech, and we can only do that if we ensure quality – even if that means catching mistakes from items provided by the client.
  • You must be self-driven: Our company is remote, meaning you’ll be working from home with occasional optional travel (optional team meetups and/or client visits). So we need people who are self-motivated, excellent at time management, tech-savvy, resourceful, adaptable, and accountable.
  • Open communication is key: Our clients trust us to translate their business needs into action items. In order to do this, there is a high level of collaboration with both clients and their stakeholders, as well as our internal teams.

You:

  • You are able to focus on both the big picture as well as get into the nitty gritty of a project
  • Excellent time management, written & verbal communication, and organization skills
  • Independent worker, but know when to get feedback or thoughts when running into issues. You aren’t afraid of constructive criticism
  • Out-of-the-box thinker – you aren’t afraid to fail or try new ideas that you haven’t tried before
  • Able to work remotely – we communicate via Gmail, Asana, Slack, Harvest, and Zoom

Requirements

  • 3+ years of paid media experience (Preferred: some years at an agency and/or in B2B SaaS & Tech)
  • Experience with Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads and Google Analytics (required)
  • Experience with Microsoft Advertising, and DSPs (preferred)
  • Ability to communicate and collaborate across marketing teams
  • Ability to effectively discuss feedback and accept constructive criticism
  • Experience working remotely (bonus - not required)

Benefits

Digital Reach is committed to diversity in its workforce. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and consider qualified applicants without regard to gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, race, veteran or disability status.

This position offers an hourly rate of $20-45/hr, anticapted hours 20-35/week.

Title:

Senior BI Platform and Analytics Engineer

KBR — Delivering Solutions, Changing the World

KBR is a global leader in delivering science, technology, and engineering solutions to governments and top tier commercial clients to overcome tomorrow’s challenges, always maintaining our commitment to Zero Harm. With a full portfolio of services, proprietary technologies and expertise, our approximately 37,000 employees are ready to handle projects and missions throughout their entire lifecycle, from planning and design to sustainability and maintenance. Whether at the bottom of the ocean or in outer space, our clients trust us to deliver the impossible on a daily basis.

KBR is seeking a Senior BI Platform and Analytics Engineer to join our IT team. This role is responsible for providing leadership in the administration, governance, and technical architecture of enterprise reporting and analytics platforms, including Microsoft Power BI, SSAS, SSRS, and supporting data infrastructure. Serves as the primary platform owner, ensuring stability, security, and long-term health of reporting environments while delivering scalable, enterprise-grade analytics solutions. Works closely with security, infrastructure, data engineering, and business teams to ensure reporting platforms are compliant, reliable, and aligned with organizational needs. Supports integration with modern data platforms such as data warehouses, data lakes, and Power BI Dataflows, ensuring consistent data consumption patterns and adherence to enterprise standards and lineage requirements.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the installation, configuration, administration, and patching of enterprise BI and reporting platforms, ensuring operational stability and performance
  • Administer and maintain SSAS, SSRS, Power BI Gateway servers, and Power BI Service tenant settings and capacities
  • Act as the primary liaison between BI, security, and infrastructure teams to ensure compliance with enterprise security and governance standards
  • Lead development, maintenance, and support of enterprise BI solutions across Power BI, SSAS Tabular, and SSRS
  • Design and maintain enterprise semantic models and SSAS Tabular models, ensuring scalability, consistency, and performance
  • Develop and support Power BI datasets, dashboards, and reports, including paginated reports for operational and executive use
  • Integrate and enable analytics using enterprise data warehouses, Azure Data Lakes, and Power BI Dataflows, ensuring adherence to data standards and lineage requirements
  • Apply appropriate data architecture patterns (lakehouse vs. warehouse) to support efficient and scalable analytics consumption
  • Develop and maintain automation solutions using PowerShell and Power Automate to support platform deployment, monitoring, data integration, alerting, and administrative processes across on-premises and Azure environments
  • Standardize operational processes to reduce risk and improve platform reliability and efficiency
  • Lead Power BI tenant-to-tenant migration initiatives, including workspace, dataset, report, and app migration
  • Perform gateway validation and reconfiguration, security model alignment, and tenant setting adjustments
  • Analyze dependencies, refactor artifacts, and validate data accuracy, refresh reliability, performance, and access controls post-migration
  • Collaborate with Azure AD, security, and infrastructure teams to manage tenant-level dependencies, including service principals, permissions, and governance controls
  • Participate in requirements gathering, solution design, and architecture planning; oversee development, QA, deployment, and training activities
  • Define and drive BI standards, governance frameworks, and best practices; evaluate technologies and perform proof-of-concepts
  • Monitor and troubleshoot platform and reporting issues, perform root cause analysis, and provide after-hours support as needed
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, including architecture, processes, and standards
  • Mentor and guide team members, support workload planning, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure successful delivery of BI solutions
  • Drive continuous improvement of platform capabilities, automation, and operational processes

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 7+ years of experience with Microsoft Power BI, including development, administration, and governance
  • 7+ years of experience supporting enterprise BI/data warehouse environments
  • 5+ years of experience with SSAS (Tabular) and SSRS
  • Strong experience administering enterprise BI platforms, including Power BI Service, gateways, SSAS, and SSRS
  • Proven experience with environment setup, configuration, patching, and platform lifecycle management
  • Experience working with security and identity teams, including Azure AD, service principals, and access governance
  • Strong expertise in automation, including PowerShell scripting and Power Automate, for workflow automation, monitoring, alerting, and administration across on-premises and Azure environments
  • Extensive experience designing and developing complex semantic models and SSAS Tabular models
  • Strong experience building Power BI datasets, reports, dashboards, and paginated reports
  • Experience leveraging modern data platforms, including Azure Data Lake/Lakehouse architecture and Power BI Dataflows
  • Strong understanding of enterprise data warehouse concepts, data modeling, and data consumption patterns
  • Experience planning and executing Power BI tenant-to-tenant migrations, including artifact migration, gateway configuration, and security alignment
  • Familiarity with migration tools, APIs, scripting, and deployment pipelines for Power BI
  • Strong SQL skills, including query development, tuning, and performance optimization
  • Experience working with SQL Server, Oracle, and related database technologies
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills
  • Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across technical and business audiences
  • Strong customer service orientation and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams

We are IT

We are strategic enablers of the business, delivering scalable, secure, and innovative technology solutions that drive operational excellence and support enterprise growth. We partner closely with functions across the organization to modernize systems, unlock data-driven insights, and enhance the digital employee experience. Our global footprint and commitment to transformation position us at the forefront of leveraging technology to create lasting business value.

Benefits: KBR offers a selection of competitive lifestyle benefits which could include a 401K plan with company match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD&D, flexible spending account, disability, paid time off, or flexible work schedule. We support career advancement through professional training and development.

Position Overview:
The Non-QM Income Scenario Specialist (Wholesale) is responsible for providing income calculations and reviews for loans prior to underwriter review. The Non-QM Income Scenario Specialist takes initiative and works with others to meet turn times and maintains customer satisfaction, while providing accurate income calculations for all specified loan types and products. This position interprets investor guidelines and applies them to the method being used to calculate income for specified investor(s). The Non-QM Income Scenario Specialist articulates these guidelines and provides explanation of the calculations and methods to all applicable parties.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Perform daily loan support for company employees via a ticketing system, inbound phone calls, email, and in person for underwriting/loan scenario-based questions and communication.

  • Review and respond to general income calculation and documentation questions while maintaining thorough knowledge of investor income guidelines.

  • Assist Loan Officers and Loan Processors in calculating income per investor guidelines and specifications; types of income to be calculated will be from sources including, but not limited to, self-employment, asset depletion, bank statement qualification, debt-service-ratios, wage earners, other income sources (capital gains, rental income, etc.).

  • Analyze various underwriting scenarios and suggest potential alternate options with different investors, as needed.

  • Review, analyze, and calculate income using complex income documentation, including personal and business tax returns, bank statements, audited/unaudited profit and loss statements, balance sheets, rental income documentation, etc. and provide calculations to be used for qualifying purposes.

  • Analyze and calculate income and determine business liquidity per investor guidelines.

  • Maintain knowledge of IRS income filing forms as they pertain to underwriting qualification, including but not limited to 1040’s, 1120-S, 1065, 1120, as well as all applicable forms, schedules, and statements within these documents.

  • Create technical documentation, system documentation, “how to” guides, FAQs, and self-help references as needed.

  • Track tasks, activities, and time spent within the ticketing system and meet expected turn-times.

  • Participate in Underwriting Department, Regional, and Sales calls, lead calls as necessary.

  • Assist with training sales or processing staff in areas where additional guidance is needed.

  • Collaborate amongst team members and other departments.

  • Maintain a working knowledge of essential underwriting information.

  • Maintain all Underwriting designations, as applicable.

  • Promote risk-awareness, ensure efficient and effective risk and compliance management practices by adhering to required standards and processes.

  • Ensure compliance with anti-money laundering and sanctions laws and regulations.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience, preferred.

  • Minimum 4 years of underwriting experience, underwriting to multiple agency and investor guidelines, preferred.

  • Jumbo/Non-Agency and Non-QM underwriting background, preferred.

  • Experience using LoanBeam and Encompass, preferred.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, customer service, and problem-solving skills.

  • Proficient with Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.

Position Overview:
The NQE Pricing Specialist is responsible for managing the pricing and rate-lock process for Non-QM mortgage loans, with a focus on exception pricing, off-sheet offerings, and risk-based pricing decisions. This role serves as a critical liaison between Sales, Credit, and Secondary Marketing to support pricing that is competitive, compliant, and aligned with CCM’s strategic objectives in a dynamic, exception-driven environment.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Report as a member of Non-QM rate lock desk, including issuing lock confirmations, tracking lock expirations, and maintaining compliance with lock policies.
  • Assess and price exception scenarios that fall outside standard rate sheets, working closely with Credit and Underwriting teams to evaluate compensating factors and layered risk.
  • Issue accurate and timely pricing quotes for Non-QM products, including base and exception-level pricing, off-sheet rates, and custom takeout pricing.
  • Analyze loan-level risk characteristics, including credit, assets, income, occupancy, and documentation; determine appropriate pricing overlays or exceptions based on investor appetite and internal guidelines. This includes evaluating non-QM terms such as prepayment penalties (PPP), debt service coverage ratio (DSCR), and alternative income documentation types.
  • Collaborate with the Secondary Marketing and Capital Markets teams to ensure that offered pricing aligns with hedge positions, investor guidelines, and market movements.
  • Monitor pipeline health and manage pricing exceptions throughout the loan lifecycle, identifying and resolving pricing discrepancies pre- and post-closing.
  • Keep abreast of market conditions, LLPA updates, investor guideline changes, and Non-QM trends that may have an impact on pricing or lock policy.
  • Document pricing exceptions and justifications thoroughly in the loan origination system and CRM, ensuring transparency and audit readiness.
  • Provide insights and reporting to management on exception trends, investor hit rates, lock fallout, and margin impact.
  • Ensure all rate lock and pricing actions adhere to compliance standards, investor requirements, and internal controls, especially within the context of the non-QM market.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience in mortgage banking.

  • Advanced experience with Non-QM guidelines, investor overlays, and borrower risk evaluation criteria.
  • Excellent analytical, quantitative, and decision-making skills.
  • Advanced collaboration and communication skills to interact effectively with Sales, Credit, Capital Markets, and external partners.
  • Excellent organizational, task-management, and attention-to-detail skills applied consistently to achieve objectives.
  • Experience with pricing engines such as Optimal Blue and LoanSifter.
  • Experience with Encompass loan origination system.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Finance Data Platform
jobs.excerpt: Our CompanyExplore how you can contribute at AmeriLife.
jobs.description:
Our Company

Explore how you can contribute at AmeriLife.

For over 50 years, AmeriLife has been a leader in the development, marketing and distribution of annuity, life and health insurance solutions for those planning for and living in retirement.

Associates get satisfaction from knowing they provide agents, marketers and carrier partners the support needed to succeed in a rapidly evolving industry.

Job Summary

AmeriLife is seeking a Senior Manager, Finance Data Platform to lead the engineering, delivery, operations, and modernization of our enterprise finance data ecosystem.

Reporting directly to the Vice President of Enterprise Data & AI Platforms, this leader will have responsibility for the Finance Data Platform (FDM) and the broader data capabilities supporting Finance, Accounting, FP&A, Commissions, Banking, General Ledger, financial reporting, attribution, reconciliation, and related financial processes.

This is a hands-on technology leadership role requiring a strong combination of enterprise data platform experience, financial data domain knowledge, engineering depth, and people leadership. The Senior Manager will lead a team of engineers and finance data specialists while working closely with Finance stakeholders to translate complex financial requirements into reliable, scalable, and well-governed data solutions.

A key mandate for this role will be evolving existing FDM capabilities into a modern, enterprise-grade Finance Data Platform built on Databricks, while maintaining the responsiveness required to support fast-moving Finance priorities and business-critical operations.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Finance Data Platform Leadership

  • Lead the engineering, delivery, operations, and ongoing evolution of the Finance Data Platform.
  • Provide day-to-day leadership for engineers, finance data specialists, and partner resources supporting FDM and related finance data capabilities.
  • Establish clear priorities across Finance enhancements, strategic initiatives, production issues, reconciliations, data quality, technical debt, and platform modernization.
  • Build an operating model that supports rapid Finance-driven changes while maintaining engineering discipline, reliability, governance, and appropriate controls.
  • Partner closely with Finance, Accounting, FP&A, Commissions, Data Architecture, Data Engineering, and enterprise technology teams.
  • Translate complex Finance requirements and business rules into scalable technical solutions and executable engineering priorities.
  • Establish clear accountability across engineering, functional expertise, QA, delivery, and operational support.

Finance & FDM Domain

  • Develop deep expertise in the existing FDM ecosystem, including its business processes, data models, transformations, integrations, dependencies, and downstream consumers.
  • Lead data capabilities supporting:
    • General Ledger and journal entries
    • P&L and financial performance
    • FP&A, budgeting, planning, and forecasting
    • Commissions and compensation
    • Banking and cash transactions
    • Revenue and expense attribution
    • Carrier, producer, policy, contract, and product financial activity
    • Entity, company, product, and organizational attribution
    • Financial reconciliation and controls
    • Management and statutory financial reporting
  • Partner with Finance stakeholders to understand calculation logic, mappings, hierarchies, allocations, attribution rules, reconciliation requirements, and reporting dependencies.
  • Ensure financial data can be traced and reconciled from source systems through transformation and downstream consumption.
  • Support integrations with financial planning, commission, accounting, reporting, and enterprise performance management platforms.

Databricks & Enterprise Data Engineering

  • Lead the modernization and migration of Finance data capabilities onto the enterpriseDatabricks Lakehouseplatform.
  • Design and oversee scalable ingestion, transformation, integration, and publishing patterns for complex financial datasets.
  • Apply modern lakehouse and medallion architecture principles across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers.
  • Drive engineering standards including reusable frameworks, metadata-driven pipelines, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, and infrastructure automation.
  • Work across databases, APIs, files, SFTP feeds, enterprise applications, and other structured and semi-structured data sources.
  • Optimize Databricks workloads for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost.
  • Maintain strong SQL and data engineering standards across the team.
  • Partner with enterprise Data Architecture and Engineering leadership on data models, integration patterns, architecture standards, and platform strategy.
  • Drive the progressive retirement and simplification of legacy FDM components as capabilities transition to the enterprise data platform.

Financial Data Modeling, Quality & Controls

  • Ensure data models appropriately represent financial transactions, accounts, entities, products, carriers, producers, policies, contracts, commissions, and organizational hierarchies.
  • Establish strong reconciliation capabilities across source systems, FDM, Databricks, General Ledger, financial applications, and downstream reporting.
  • Ensure appropriate historical tracking, auditability, lineage, and point-in-time analysis for critical financial data.
  • Partner with Data Architecture and Governance teams to establish consistent business definitions, metadata, lineage, ownership, and data quality standards.
  • Establish automated controls for completeness, accuracy, timeliness, duplication, referential integrity, and financial reconciliation.
  • Ensure appropriate security and access controls for sensitive financial information.
  • Drive root-cause analysis and permanent remediation of recurring data quality and reconciliation issues.

Delivery & Operational Excellence

  • Lead execution across Finance data projects, enhancements, defects, operational requests, and production issues.
  • Establish a delivery model capable of supporting fast-paced Finance requirements that may not always align to traditional sprint-based development cycles.
  • Create clear processes for distinguishing and managing enhancements, strategic projects, production incidents, defects, and recurring operational activities.
  • Balance immediate Finance priorities with long-term platform modernization and technical sustainability.
  • Establish service expectations, prioritization mechanisms, escalation paths, and measurable delivery outcomes.
  • Reduce manual processing and operational dependencies through automation and engineering improvements.
  • Establish monitoring, alerting, incident management, and production-readiness practices for critical Finance data pipelines.
  • Coordinate internal teams and external delivery partners while maintaining clear internal accountability for outcomes.

People Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing Finance Data Platform team.
  • Build a team with the right combination of data engineering, financial domain, functional, and operational expertise.
  • Develop team members’ understanding of both the technology and the financial processes supported by the platform.
  • Create clear ownership and accountability while enabling engineers and specialists to operate with appropriate autonomy.
  • Manage internal employees, contractors, and strategic delivery partners.
  • Participate in hiring, workforce planning, performance management, and capability development as the Finance Data Platform organization evolves.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience across data engineering, enterprise data platforms, data architecture, financial data systems, or related disciplines.
  • 3+ years of experience leading data engineering, data platform, or financial data teams.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, or operatinglarge-scale enterprise data platformssupporting business-critical workloads.
  • Strong hands-on experience withDatabricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, or comparable modern cloud data technologies.
  • Advanced SQL skills with strong knowledge of data engineering, ETL/ELT, integration, pipeline design, and performance optimization.
  • Strong experience with cloud platforms such asAzure or AWS.
  • Strong understanding of financial data and processes, including multiple areas such asP&L, FP&A, General Ledger, commissions, banking, journal entries, financial reporting, reconciliation, allocations, attribution, planning, and forecasting.
  • Experience supporting data environments where accuracy, auditability, lineage, reconciliation, and financial controls are critical.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise data modeling, dimensional modeling, and modern lakehouse architectures.
  • Experience managing production data workloads and resolving complex data, pipeline, reconciliation, and platform issues.
  • Experience implementing automated testing, monitoring, data quality, CI/CD, and production controls.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex Finance requirements into scalable data solutions.
  • Proven ability to lead teams operating across strategic initiatives, rapid enhancements, and business-critical production responsibilities.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills with the ability to partner effectively with Finance and senior technology leaders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building, leading, or modernizing aFinance Data Platform, Finance Data Mart, Finance Data Warehouse, or comparable financial data ecosystem.
  • Experience migrating legacySQL Server, SSIS, ADF, stored procedure, or traditional data warehouseworkloads to Databricks or another cloud-native platform.
  • Experience with commission and incentive compensation platforms such asVaricentor comparable technologies.
  • Experience with financial planning, consolidation, and performance management platforms such asOneStreamor similar solutions.
  • Experience within insurance, financial services, distribution, commissions, or other transaction-intensive industries.
  • Experience working with master and reference data involving companies, legal entities, carriers, products, producers, policies, contracts, accounts, and organizational hierarchies.
  • Familiarity withData Vault 2.0, dimensional modeling, medallion architecture, Unity Catalog, data lineage, and modern data governance practices.
  • Experience managing blended teams consisting of employees, contractors, and strategic delivery partners.
  • Databricks certification and/or relevant Azure or AWS certifications preferred.

Leadership Profile

The ideal candidate combines the mindset of aFinance data leader, hands-on data engineer, and platform operator. This individual should be equally comfortable discussing a P&L or commission reconciliation with Finance, reviewing SQL and pipeline logic with an engineer, diagnosing a production data issue, challenging a data model, and defining the roadmap for modernizing FDM capabilities on Databricks. Success in this role requires strong technical judgment, financial data fluency, operational discipline, and the ability to bring structure to a fast-moving environment without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy. The Senior Manager will be expected to make the Finance Data Platform increasingly scalable, automated, governed, and reliable while preserving the responsiveness Finance requires from a mission-critical data function.

Compensation

  • Salary: $150,000
  • This role may be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus.
  • Salary offers will vary commensurate with experience, education, skills, and training

What AmeriLife Offers

A comprehensive benefits package that includes PTO, medical, dental, vision, retirement savings, disability insurance, and life insurance.

CPQ Development & Configuration

jobs.description:
Job Title: Field CTO, RSA ID Plus

Location: United States (Remote)

Reports to: VP Product, Access Management

RSA provides trusted identity and access management for 12,000 organizations around the world, managing 25 million enterprise identities and providing secure, convenient access to millions of users. RSA specializes in empowering security-first organizations in financial services, healthcare, energy, technology services, and other industries to thrive in a digital world, delivering complete capabilities for modern authentication, access, lifecycle management, and identity governance. Whether in the cloud or on-premises, RSA connects people with the digital resources they depend on everywhere they live, work, and play.

For decades, RSA has pioneered many of the encryption, authentication, and identity federation technologies that still power the internet. And now RSA is transforming the industry yet again, paving the way for the future of digital identity through the RSA Unified Identity Platform; next-generation hybrid and cloud solutions; the first ever and only multi-functional, passwordless hardware authenticator; and a frictionless, mobile-optimized experience for the modern workforce. If you are self-motivated and looking for a fast-paced challenge doing something that truly matters, come join our winning team! For more information, go to rsa.com.

Why This Role Matters

Identity is the control plane of modern zero trust security, and Access Management is at its very core. Every application, workload, and AI agent now asks the same question before anything else happens: who is this user, and should they be granted access? Access Management is where these question gets answered, thousands of times per second, for organizations that cannot afford to get it wrong. Today, a confluence of market forces—including emerging anti-phishing mandates, sophisticated AI-powered threats, and the rise of agentic and other non-human identities—are dramatically reshaping the Access Management landscape and opening new opportunities for innovation and growth.

RSA ID Plus sits at the center of this market shift. Recognized as a leading Access Management solution with more than 3000 customers in 100+ countries worldwide, RSA ID Plus is trusted by the world’s most security-sensitive organizations including 70% of Fortune 100 Financial Services, 90% of US Federal Agencies, and more that 65 International Governments around the globe. What makes RSA different is our cybersecurity DNA, 40+ years of redefining the identity security market, and our laser focus on securing the world’s most secure. RSA ID Plus is the only identity platform that provides true passwordless from cloud to desktop to the datacenter, ensures continuous assurance beyond phishing to tackle today’s most advanced identity threats, and can be deployed in any environment including multi-tenant SaaS, private cloud, on-premises, and even air-gapped environments.

Job Description

The Field CTO is the most senior technical voice for RSA ID Plus in the market. This individual will serve as a trusted advisor to CISOs, CIOs, and enterprise architects at our most strategic accounts, shape the technical narrative for the platform, and represent RSA with industry analysts, at industry events, and in the public forum. The role sits at the intersection of technology, strategy, and the field: equally comfortable whiteboarding a zero trust architecture with a customer's security team and briefing executives on where the identity market is heading.

The successful candidate must be a recognized identity and cybersecurity expert with the credibility to hold the room in front of a Fortune 100 security organization or a federal agency, and the commercial instinct to turn that credibility into pipeline and design wins. Just as importantly, they will carry what they learn in the field back into the business, translating customer conversations, competitive encounters, and market signals into a sharper strategy and a stronger story for ID Plus. This is a highly visible, self-directed role for someone who thrives on a large cross-functional team and leads through influence rather than authority.

The successful Field CTO will:

  • Serve as trusted technical advisor to RSA's most strategic customers and prospects, engaging CISOs, CIOs, and enterprise architects on identity strategy, zero trust architecture, and modernization roadmaps.
  • Act as the primary technical evangelist for ID Plus through keynotes, conference sessions, webinars, whitepapers, and executive briefings, and lead analyst briefings alongside Product Management and Product Marketing.
  • Support complex, high-value sales cycles in regulated and enterprise environments, partnering with Sales and Solution Architecture to remove technical obstacles and win architectural decisions.
  • Maintain a rigorous view of the competitive landscape, from technical capability comparisons to positioning implications, and equip the field with the arguments needed to win against it.
  • Partner with Product Management and Product Marketing to shape platform strategy, refine positioning and messaging, and feed field insight into long-range strategic planning.
  • Build the technical credibility of the broader field organization through enablement, architecture guidance, and mentoring of solution architects and sales engineers.

Qualifications

  • 12+ years in senior technical roles such as Field CTO, Chief Architect, Principal Solution Architect, or Security Strategist, with extensive customer-facing experience.
  • Deep subject matter expertise in Identity & Access Management principles, including major technology standards in authentication (NIST SP800-63, FIDO2, X.509), federation and authorization (SAML, OAuth 2.0, OIDC), and emerging technologies (SSF, Verifiable Credentials).
  • Demonstrated ability to design and defend enterprise security architectures across SaaS, private cloud, on-premises, and air-gapped environments.
  • Proven executive presence and commercial acumen, with a track record of advising CISOs and CIOs and influencing large, complex enterprise sales cycles without owning a quota.
  • Established industry voice, evidenced by conference speaking, published thought leadership, analyst engagement, or standards body participation.
  • Strong analytical skills and command of the competitive landscape, able to translate technical differentiation into defensible positioning and messaging, and to contribute that insight to product strategy and long-range planning.
  • Superior written and verbal communication skills, equally effective on a keynote stage, in a customer architecture review, and in an executive strategy discussion.
  • Independent self-starter who sets direction in ambiguity and operates effectively across a large, globally distributed organization.
  • Willingness to travel up to 30% for customer meetings, industry events, and speaking engagements.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Computer Science; advanced degree a plus.

Pay Range $170,000 - $270,000

Full-time, non-Sales US employees are also eligible for annual discretionary bonuses that are funded based on prior year company performance. RSA Sales team members are eligible to participate in company commission plans.

In addition, RSA offers its eligible US employees a comprehensive array of benefit programs including flexible paid-time-off, health, disability, and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions.

All employment decisions at RSA are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. All RSA employees are expected to support this policy and contribute to an environment of equal opportunity.

Role Overview
As an Expert Audio Transcriber, you will convert audio recordings of native Tagalog speakers into precise, conventionally formatted written transcripts. Your work will directly impact the quality of speech recognition, dialogue systems, and AI evaluation products used by major AI labs.

You will work with diverse audio sources ranging from clean studio recordings to natural conversations in real-world settings, applying expert linguistic judgment to ensure exceptional transcription accuracy and consistency.

  • Focus on Tagalog and Filipino as spoken across Luzon and Metro Manila, including Taglish (natural Tagalog-English code-switching)

Required Qualifications - Must-have Requirements

  5. At least 2 years of professional transcription experience
  6. Experience in captioning, court reporting, broadcast, translation, or linguistic annotation
  7. Demonstrated word-level accuracy under deadline pressure
  8. Comfortable using web-based annotation platforms

  • Direct collaboration with Perle’s linguistic leads and QA teams

Location

jobs.excerpt: Being sick or injured is painful.  Getting better shouldn’t be.
jobs.description:
Being sick or injured is painful. Getting better shouldn’t be.

Most industries have been transformed by new technology. Healthcare is still waiting — and you can help change that.

Our mission is simple but ambitious: make healthcare accessible, transparent, and effortless for all. We put the consumer at the center, move fast and partner with forward-thinking providers to deliver software that makes care better, faster, and more human. This is work with real-world stakes — and you can help lead the way.

Solv is building AI-powered healthcare infrastructure that makes everyday care easier for patients and the teams who care for them—from finding and receiving care to helping clinics reduce manual work, improve access, and run better operations.

Near-term work will likely include voice and other AI agents supporting scheduling, billing, and additional healthcare workflows. However, this is a broader product-engineering role, and the problems and technologies will evolve.

We’re looking for a senior generalist with strong web fundamentals, product judgment, curiosity, and ownership. You will work closely with a product manager to shape solutions while owning technical decisions, execution, production quality, and results.

You do not need to have worked professionally on an AI-native team, but meaningful hands-on AI work is required. That experience may come from production work, internal tools, prototypes, open source, personal projects, or self-directed experimentation.

You can expect to:

  • Partner with product, design, customers, and engineers to turn business and user problems into shipped improvements.
  • Build across the full stack, including frontend experiences, backend services, APIs, relational data models, integrations, and AI-powered workflows.
  • Take ideas from early exploration through implementation, production rollout, and iteration.
  • Build scrappy prototypes to learn quickly, then develop reliable production systems when an opportunity is proven.
  • Improve AI systems using evaluations, production traces, customer feedback, product data, and operational signals.
  • Design for uncertainty through testing, observability, guardrails, fallbacks, auditability, and human escalation.
  • Build enterprise healthcare products that account for privacy, permissions, edge cases, data quality, reliability, and supportability.
  • Explore new AI capabilities while balancing speed, quality, safety, cost, customer value, and maintainability.
  • Use AI development tools extensively while retaining ownership of technical decisions and production quality.

You’d be great for this role if you:

  • Have 5+ years of experience building and maintaining production web applications.
  • Have strong senior-level fundamentals across frontend development, backend architecture, APIs, relational database design, testing, performance, and production debugging.
  • Take ownership of ambiguous problems: you investigate deeply, create clarity, make sound decisions, and drive work forward without waiting for a fully specified solution.
  • Have built or deeply explored an AI system beyond basic prompting or a thin API wrapper. Examples include a RAG pipeline, automated or tool-using agent, evaluation system, AI workflow, or model adaptation or post-training experiment.
  • Can explain what you built, why you chose the approach, where it failed, how you evaluated it, and what you learned.
  • Actively investigate emerging AI capabilities through hands-on experimentation and can identify where they may create meaningful product or business value.
  • Know how to move quickly without confusing a promising prototype with a production-ready system.
  • Work effectively with product managers while independently owning technical decisions and execution.
  • Are willing to talk directly with customers, understand their workflows, and turn their problems into shipped improvements.
  • Are motivated by measurable patient, customer, and business outcomes.
  • Bring high standards, low ego, and a willingness to dig into whatever problem will help the team succeed.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with LLM applications, agents, retrieval, tool calling, evaluations, or AI observability.
  • Experience with voice systems, telephony, or conversational interfaces.
  • Experience with healthcare workflows, HIPAA, or protected health information.
  • Experience building enterprise products with complex integrations and operational workflows.
  • Experience with React, Remix, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, Postgres, or similar technologies.

This is fundamentally a senior product-engineering role, not an ML research position. Our technical interview is grounded in frontend, backend, APIs, system design, and relational database design. We will also want to understand what you have built with AI, how deeply you explored it, and what you learned.

Tu feras partie de la team Opérations, et plus particulièrement de l’équipe juridique, sous la responsabilité de Julie.

🧑‍🎓Master II en droit (idéalement droit du numérique / NTIC ou équivalent)
